title.zh-TW: Opus 5.5 成為預設 Opus，Pro 方案也改用 Opus
title.en: Opus 5.5 becomes the default Opus, and Pro plans now default to Opus

body.zh-TW: Claude Opus 5.5（`claude-opus-5-5`）上線，直接成為預設的 Opus 模型，一次能讀 1M 上下文。價格是每百萬 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）輸入 4 美元、輸出 20 美元。讀取快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）每百萬只要 0.20 美元。Pro 與 Team Standard 方案的預設模型也從 Sonnet 改為 Opus，與 Max、Team Premium 及 Enterprise 看齊。思考力度也有調整：以前存下的設定不再套用到 Opus 5.5 這類新模型；Opus 4.7、Opus 4.8 與 Fable 5 也不再讓出廠預設值覆蓋 `-p`、SDK、專案或設定檔的 `effortLevel`。
body.en: The latest flagship model Claude Opus 5.5, under the identifier `claude-opus-5-5`, is now the default Opus model and offers a 1M context window. Pricing is $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, with cache reads at $0.20 per million tokens. The default model for Pro and Team Standard plans has also changed from Sonnet to Opus, matching Max, Team Premium, and Enterprise. For thinking effort, settings saved in older versions no longer apply to new models like Opus 5.5. Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8, and Fable 5 also no longer let their launch defaults override `effortLevel` configured via `-p`, the SDK, projects, or settings files.

items.original:
Added Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`), now the default Opus model — 1M context, $4/$20 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
Changed the default model on Pro and Team Standard plans from Sonnet to Opus, matching Max, Team Premium, and Enterprise
Changed an effort level saved before `/effort` became per-model to no longer apply to newly released models such as Opus 5.5; they start at their default until you pick a level
Changed Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8 and Fable 5 to stop holding their launch-default effort over `/effort` in `-p` or the Agent SDK, a project, managed or `--settings` `effortLevel`, or a per-model level

title.zh-TW: 寫檔先認清真實路徑，自動模式的安全檢查不再狂重試
title.en: File writes check the real path, and auto mode's safety check stops hammering retries

body.zh-TW: 讓 Claude 自己改檔案時，它現在會先看清楚檔案真正落在哪裡。透過符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）寫入檔案時，提示詞會明確指出實際寫入的落點位置。如果真實目標落在專案目錄外，`acceptEdits`、允許規則與自動模式都不再放行。在自動模式下，如果安全檢查拒絕審查某項操作，該操作會直接被拒絕一次，並提示重試沒有幫助。若安全檢查沒有任何回應，Claude Code 會逐步拉長重試間隔，連續十次無回應就會停止該輪對話並顯示說明訊息。模型呼叫 Write 工具時如果傳入 `path`、`file_text`、`file_content` 或多餘的 `description` 等非標準參數，也能正確通過驗證。
body.en: When Claude edits files on its own, it now checks where a file really lands. When writing to a file through a symlink, the prompt explicitly states where the write actually lands. If the real target sits outside the project directory, `acceptEdits`, allow rules, and auto mode will no longer approve it. In auto mode, if a safety check declines to review an action, the action is denied once with a notice that retrying will not help. If a safety check gives no response, retries now back off with increasing intervals, stopping the turn with an explanatory message after ten consecutive non-responses. In addition, Write tool calls that pass non-standard parameters such as `path`, `file_text`, `file_content`, or a stray `description` now pass validation properly.

items.original:
Fixed writes through a symlinked path being judged by their in-tree spelling: the prompt names where the write lands, and `acceptEdits`, allow rules and auto mode no longer approve one landing outside
Fixed auto mode retrying an action over and over when a safety check declined to review it; the action is now denied once, noting that retrying won't help
Fixed auto mode denying actions over and over without pause when a safety check gave no answer; retries now back off, and the turn stops with a message after ten in a row
Fixed Write calls failing validation when a model sends `path`, `file_text`, `file_content` or a stray `description` instead of `file_path` and `content`

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕清單支援滑鼠滾輪，對話框按鍵一併修正
title.en: Fullscreen lists take the mouse wheel, and dialog keys get fixed

body.zh-TW:
在全螢幕裡捲清單、點選項，現在不必再跟對話框搶操作。你可以使用滑鼠滾輪捲動 `/skills` 清單，並點擊 `/plugin` 中的技能狀態選項。全螢幕下滾輪無法捲動含隱藏項目的清單（例如 `/model` 與 `/permissions`）已修復。在下列對話框中連按兩次 Ctrl+C 或 Ctrl+D 只會關閉對話框，不再退出程式：

```
/model, /effort, /config, /status, /usage, /plugin, /sandbox, /permissions,
/artifacts, /mobile, /login, /upgrade, /usage-credits, /install-github-app,
/setup-bedrock, /setup-vertex
```

點擊視窗喚回前景時，不再誤觸游標底下的搜尋器、分頁列、代理與工作流程列、指令連結或選單。對話框取消按 y 或 n 鍵直接確認關閉，改用 Enter 確認與 Esc 取消（可在 `keybindings.json` 綁定 `confirm:yes` 與 `confirm:no` 還原）；文字輸入框也不再因快捷鍵遺失輸入的英數或空白。
body.en:
Scrolling lists and clicking options in fullscreen no longer means fighting the dialogs. You can use the mouse wheel to scroll the `/skills` list and click on a skill's state options in `/plugin`. An issue where the wheel could not scroll lists with hidden items in fullscreen mode (such as `/model` and `/permissions`) has been fixed. Pressing Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D twice in the following dialogs now only closes the dialog instead of exiting the program:

```
/model, /effort, /config, /status, /usage, /plugin, /sandbox, /permissions,
/artifacts, /mobile, /login, /upgrade, /usage-credits, /install-github-app,
/setup-bedrock, /setup-vertex
```

Clicking a window to bring it to the foreground no longer accidentally triggers items under the pointer—such as search pickers, tab bars, agent and workflow rows, command links, or dropdowns. Dialogs no longer confirm or close on a stray y or n key, switching to Enter to accept and Esc to cancel (you can bind `confirm:yes` and `confirm:no` in `keybindings.json` to restore this behavior). In addition, text input fields in dialogs no longer lose typed letters, numbers, or spaces to matching keybindings.

items.original:
Added mouse support to more lists in fullscreen mode: the wheel scrolls the `/skills` list, and a skill's state options in `/plugin` can be clicked
Fixed Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D pressed twice in most dialogs (`/model`, `/effort`, `/config`, `/status`, `/usage`, `/plugin`, `/sandbox`, `/permissions`, `/artifacts`, `/mobile`, `/login`, `/upgrade`, `/usage-credits`, `/install-github-app`, `/setup-bedrock`, `/setup-vertex`) quitting Claude Code instead of closing the dialog
Fixed a click that only brought the terminal window to the front also triggering the item under the pointer — in search pickers, tab bars, agent/workflow rows, slash-command links and suggestion dropdowns
Fixed a stray `n` closing dialogs and a stray `y` confirming them; Enter and Esc accept and cancel (bind `y`/`n` to `confirm:yes`/`confirm:no` in `keybindings.json` to restore)
Fixed text fields in dialogs losing a typed letter, digit or Space to a keybinding on that key
Fixed the mouse wheel not scrolling selection lists with hidden options (such as `/model` and `/permissions`) in fullscreen mode

title.zh-TW: 輸入框、語音聽寫與暫存提示詞的一批修正
title.en: A batch of fixes for the input box, voice dictation, and stashed prompts

body.zh-TW: 打字、語音聽寫、暫存提示詞，這幾種輸入方式各修了一些小毛病。在 Windows 終端機中，按 Enter 清理不可見字元後會重新繪製畫面，讓你能看清楚送出的實際文字。不可見字元清理也不再誤刪波斯文與阿拉伯文用來連接字尾的零寬不連字元。語音聽寫時按下 Ctrl+C 會立即停止麥克風收音，在轉錄處理過程中按下 Esc 能順利取消，在轉錄檢視畫面與 vim NORMAL 模式下長按空白鍵也不會意外啟動聽寫。啟動掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）執行時按 Esc，或是編輯、倒帶讓提示詞回到輸入框時，IDE 選取的內容不會再遺失。使用 Ctrl+S 暫存的 `!` shell 模式提示詞，取回時依然維持 shell 模式，暫存後輸入 `/` 也能立即列出檔案路徑。
body.en: Typing, voice dictation, and stashed prompts each got a few small fixes. On Windows terminals, the screen repaints after invisible characters are removed on Enter, letting you clearly review the exact text being sent. Invisible character cleanup also no longer removes the zero-width non-joiner used in Persian and Arabic text to attach suffixes. For voice dictation, pressing Ctrl+C stops microphone recording immediately, Esc cleanly cancels while a transcript is processing, and holding Space in the transcript view or vim NORMAL mode will not accidentally trigger dictation. IDE selections are no longer lost when pressing Esc while startup hooks run, or when editing or rewinding brings a sent prompt back into the input box. A `!` shell-mode prompt stashed with Ctrl+S remains in shell mode when restored, and typing `/` immediately lists file paths after stashing.

items.original:
Fixed the prompt line staying scrambled on Windows terminals after invisible characters were removed on Enter; the screen is now repainted so you review the exact text that will be sent
Fixed the invisible-character cleanup removing the zero-width non-joiner that Persian and Arabic text uses to attach a suffix to a Latin word or number, such as the plural of "PDF"
Fixed voice dictation not stopping on Ctrl+C (the prompt cleared but the microphone kept recording), Esc not cancelling while a transcript was processing, and held Space starting dictation from the transcript view and vim NORMAL mode
Fixed IDE selection being dropped when a sent prompt comes back into the input, such as pressing Esc to edit it, rewinding to it, or pressing Esc while startup hooks run
Fixed a `!` shell-mode prompt stashed with Ctrl+S coming back as a plain prompt when restored, and `/` listing file paths right after stashing one

title.zh-TW: 換模型不再讓快取失效，/cost 會說明快取為何沒命中
title.en: Switching models no longer breaks the cache, and /cost explains cache misses

body.zh-TW: 切換模型或接手子代理，最怕快取整個重算、白等一輪。當你在外部宿主應用程式中切換模型時，即使 Claude 正在執行任務，也不會再導致下一個提示詞發生快取未命中。外部宿主包含 Claude Desktop、VS Code 或 SDK。讀取快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）時，從分支復原的子代理會重新發送最初使用的工具清單，避免重建清單而破壞快取。`/cost` 指令說明快取沒命中的原因時，現在也會標出思考模式或思考顯示設定的變更。
body.en: Switching models or taking over a subagent used to risk a full cache recompute and a wasted wait. When switching models from an external host application while Claude is working, the next prompt will no longer suffer a cache miss. Supported host applications include Claude Desktop, VS Code, and the SDK. When reading cache, resumed fork subagents re-send the tool list they originally used rather than rebuilding the list, preventing cache breakage. In addition, cache miss explanations in the `/cost` command have been improved to explicitly identify changes in thinking mode or thinking display settings.

items.original:
Fixed a model switch made from a host app (Claude Desktop, VS Code, SDK) while Claude is working causing a prompt-cache miss on the next prompt
Fixed resumed fork subagents rebuilding their tool list instead of re-sending the one they first used, which broke prompt caching for that agent
Improved `/cost` cache-miss causes to name thinking mode and thinking display changes

title.zh-TW: 外掛更新支援 Git 憑證庫，冒充官方市集的名稱會被擋
title.en: Plugin updates work with Git credential helpers, and names posing as the official marketplace are blocked

body.zh-TW: 裝了外掛或技能的人，這次更新比較不會出錯。背景外掛市集自動更新現在支援 Git 憑證庫（存登入證明的地方），私有儲存庫市集不再每次都重新複製或無法更新。當你從追蹤分支或標籤的 GitHub 儲存庫或 Git 網址更新外掛時，`installed_plugins.json` 會更新為最新修訂版本，不再保留安裝時的舊紀錄。執行 `claude plugin update` 時，若官方市集的快照檔案為連結或體積過大，也不會再將外掛版本誤標為未知。技能這邊，當 `~/.claude/skills/` 內包含列出技能名稱的 `manifest.json` 時，該目錄下的技能不再被意外移入 `.trash` 資料夾。新增外掛市集時，名稱如果模仿保留的官方市集名稱會直接被拒絕，已新增的也會停止載入。
body.en: If you use plugins or skills, updating them is less error-prone now. Background plugin marketplace auto-updates now support Git credential helpers, ensuring private repository marketplaces no longer re-clone every run or fail to update. When updating plugins from a GitHub repository or Git URL tracking a branch or tag, `installed_plugins.json` updates to the latest revision instead of keeping the install-time commit. Running `claude plugin update` also no longer misidentifies plugin versions as unknown when the official marketplace snapshot file is a link or too large. For skills, items in `~/.claude/skills/` are no longer accidentally moved to the `.trash` folder when a `manifest.json` in that folder lists their names. Furthermore, adding a plugin marketplace whose name imitates a reserved official marketplace name is rejected immediately, and existing ones stop loading.

items.original:
Fixed `installed_plugins.json` keeping the install-time commit after updating a plugin from a GitHub repository or git URL that tracks a branch or tag
Fixed skills in `~/.claude/skills/` being moved to `~/.claude/skills/.trash/` when a `manifest.json` in that folder listed their names
Fixed background plugin marketplace auto-update ignoring git credential helpers, so private-repo marketplaces were re-cloned every run or never updated
Fixed `claude plugin update` clearing a plugin's recorded commit and moving it to version "unknown" when the official marketplace's snapshot file is a link or too large
Changed plugin marketplaces whose name imitates a reserved marketplace name to be refused when added, and to stop loading if one was already added

title.zh-TW: 圖示與顏色的一批修正：關閉的技能不再像載入失敗
title.en: Icon and color fixes: disabled skills no longer look like failed loads

body.zh-TW: 這批是畫面上的小圖示和顏色修正，看狀態時比較不會誤會。在淺色與 ANSI 主題下，工作階段意見回饋調查現在會正常顯示游標停留時的高亮效果。執行 `/workflows` 時，若只有一筆執行紀錄，會直接開啟該紀錄，不再短暫閃過單行清單。在 `/plugin` 與 `/skills` 中，關閉的技能改以暗色圓圈 ◯ 顯示，不再與載入失敗外掛的紅色 ✘ 混淆。多選選項的說明文字縮排位置已校正至標籤文字下方，不再縮排在選項編號底下。全螢幕模式下 `/plugin`、`/skills` 與 `/mcp` 的搜尋框右邊框不再遺失。伺服器有警告時在 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器清單、詳細檢視畫面與 `/plugin` 中一律統一顯示為 ⚠ 圖示。
body.en: This batch fixes small icons and colors on screen, so statuses are harder to misread. On light and ANSI themes, the session feedback survey now properly displays hover highlights. Running `/workflows` with only a single execution record directly opens that run instead of briefly flashing a one-row list. In `/plugin` and `/skills`, disabled skills are now represented with a dim circle ◯, avoiding confusion with the red ✘ used for failed plugin loads. Multi-select option descriptions are now properly indented under the label text instead of under the option number. The search box in `/plugin`, `/skills`, and `/mcp` no longer loses its right border in fullscreen mode. Finally, servers with warnings now consistently display a ⚠ icon across the MCP server list, detail views, and `/plugin`.

items.original:
Fixed the session feedback survey showing no hover highlight on light and ANSI themes
Fixed `/workflows` briefly showing a one-row list before opening the only run
Fixed a skill you switched off showing the same red ✘ as a plugin that failed to load in `/plugin` and `/skills`; off now shows a dim ◯
Fixed multi-select option descriptions being indented under the option number instead of under the label
Fixed the search box in `/plugin`, `/skills` and `/mcp` losing its right border in fullscreen mode
Fixed `/mcp` showing △ in the server list but ⚠ in the detail view for the same server; the list, detail views and `/plugin` now all show ⚠

title.zh-TW: Home、End、PgUp 等按鍵在選單裡恢復正常
title.en: Home, End, PgUp and other keys work properly in menus

body.zh-TW: 習慣用鍵盤在選單裡跳來跳去的人，這幾個按鍵現在會照你想的動。在 `/config` 設定清單以及 `/model`、`/memory` 和權限提示等選單中，按 Home 與 End 鍵現在能正確跳至最頂端與最底端。在 `/skills` 選單中按 PgUp 與 PgDn 鍵時，選取游標會停在第一個或最後一個技能，不再循環繞回另一端。在 `/config` 清單中按 Tab 鍵不再默默更改選定設定的值，改為不觸發任何變更。全螢幕模式下的 `Ctrl+L` 與 `Cmd+K` 恢復原本的重繪畫面功能，不再清除轉錄檢視內容。`/autocompact` 的頁尾提示已更新為使用 `←` 與 `→` 調整數值，`/fast` 的頁尾也明確標示空白鍵為切換開關。
body.en: If you move through menus with the keyboard, these keys now do what you expect. In the `/config` settings list, as well as selection lists such as `/model`, `/memory`, and permission prompts, pressing Home and End now jumps to the very top and bottom. In the `/skills` menu, pressing PgUp and PgDn stops the selection on the first or last skill rather than wrapping around. Pressing Tab in the `/config` list no longer silently changes the selected setting's value, instead doing nothing there. `Ctrl+L` and `Cmd+K` in fullscreen mode restore their original screen repainting behavior rather than clearing the transcript view. In addition, the footer hint for `/autocompact` now lists `←` and `→` for adjusting values, while the footer for `/fast` explicitly identifies Space as the toggle key.

items.original:
Fixed Home and End doing nothing in the `/config` settings list and in selection lists such as `/model`, `/memory` and permission prompts
Fixed PgUp/PgDn in the `/skills` menu wrapping past the first or last skill instead of stopping there
Fixed Tab silently changing the selected setting's value in the `/config` list; it now does nothing there
Reverted `ctrl+l` / `cmd+k` in fullscreen mode clearing the transcript view (added in 2.1.260); they redraw the screen again
Changed `/autocompact`'s footer hint to name ←/→, the keys that adjust other ordered values
Changed `/fast`'s footer to name Space as the toggle key

title.zh-TW: 一筆壞紀錄不再卡死整段對話
title.en: One bad record no longer stalls a whole conversation

body.zh-TW: 工作階段拖得越久，越怕一筆壞紀錄讓整段對話停擺。對話請求不再因為角色順序問題而拋出系統角色必須在助理訊息之前的 API 錯誤。開啟顧問模式時，若在不支援 `advisor_20260301` 標籤的代理伺服器或閘道後方遇到 API 400 錯誤，Claude Code 會自動拿掉該標籤重試。當工作階段儲存的歷史紀錄中包含無法載入的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具錯誤通知時，對話與 `/compact` 不再每輪報錯。當儲存的轉錄紀錄包含格式損毀的系統訊息或缺少檔案清單的記憶體儲存通知時，復原工作階段不再發生崩潰。全螢幕長工作階段若發生損毀，損壞的快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）訊息清單現在會自動重建，避免跳出無法復原的介面錯誤而中斷。
body.en: The longer a session runs, the more one bad record can threaten to stall the whole conversation. Conversations no longer fail on turn requests with an API error stating that role 'system' must precede an 'assistant' message. When advisor mode is enabled behind a proxy or gateway that does not support the `advisor_20260301` tag, API Error 400 requests automatically retry without the tag. When saved session history contains a malformed notice about unloaded MCP tools, turns and `/compact` no longer fail on every turn. Resuming a session no longer crashes when its saved transcript holds a malformed system message or a memory-saved notice missing its file list. When long-running fullscreen sessions encounter corruption, damaged cached message lists are automatically rebuilt, preventing unrecoverable interface errors from aborting the run.

items.original:
Fixed conversations failing on every turn with a "role 'system' must precede an 'assistant' message" API error
Fixed conversations with the advisor on failing every turn with API Error 400 "Input tag 'advisor_20260301'" behind a proxy or gateway that doesn't support it; the request now retries without it
Fixed a session failing on every turn and `/compact` when its saved history held a malformed notice about MCP tools that could not be loaded
Fixed a crash when resuming a session whose saved transcript holds a malformed system message or a memory-saved notice without its file list
Fixed one cause of long-running fullscreen sessions exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error": a damaged cached message list is now rebuilt

title.zh-TW: 設定檔被換掉或留著舊值時不再卡死
title.en: Settings files no longer hang or crash on swaps and stale values

body.zh-TW: 兩個跟設定檔有關的卡死與當機修好了。當設定檔或編輯後重新讀取的檔案在讀取過程中被具名管道替換時，Claude Code 不再無限期卡死等待。另一個是：某個設定項目已經移至 `settings.json`，但 `~/.claude.json` 中仍然殘留 `null` 或 `"false"` 等舊值時，開啟 `/config` 不會再發生崩潰，各項開關偏好也能被正確讀取。⟦像換了新手機，通訊錄裡還留著幾筆舊手機帶過來的空白聯絡人，以前一打開就閃退，現在照常打開、該讀的都讀得到。⟧
body.en: Two settings-file hangs and crashes are fixed. When a settings file or a file being re-read after an edit is replaced by a named pipe mid-read, Claude Code no longer hangs indefinitely. In addition, when a preference has moved to `settings.json` while `~/.claude.json` still holds a legacy value like `null` or `"false"`, opening `/config` no longer crashes, and toggle preferences are parsed accurately. ⟦Picture a new phone that still carries a few blank contacts from the old one: the address book used to crash on them, and now it opens normally and reads everything it should.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Claude Code hanging when a settings file, or a file it re-reads after an edit, is replaced by a named pipe mid-read
Fixed `/config` crashing and some on/off preferences being misread when a preference that has moved to `settings.json` still holds a value like `null` or `"false"` in `~/.claude.json`

title.zh-TW: 背景子代理的訊息與報告不再遺失，Ctrl+C 按兩下就能退出
title.en: Background subagent messages and reports stop getting lost, and two Ctrl+C presses exit

body.zh-TW: 把工作丟給背景子代理（在背後替你跑任務的小助手）的人，這批修正讓交接不再掉東西。在無頭模式（沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）與 SDK 工作階段中，當背景子代理正在結束該輪對話時，傳送給它的訊息不會再默默遺失。當啟動子代理的主對話在讀取報告前執行了壓縮，已完成子代理的調查結果也不會再丟失。當 LSP 外掛啟用時，背景子代理現在能順利使用 LSP 工具進行程式碼語意分析。在背景子代理執行期間，按下兩次 Ctrl+C 即可順利退出，不再需要連續按三到四次。復原包含未完成背景代理、shell 或工作流程的工作階段時，不會再於你輸入前自行啟動模型對話。在非詳細模式下展開子代理交接訊息時，不再顯示內部的來源前言字串。
body.en: If you hand work to background subagents, these fixes stop things from getting lost in the handoff. In headless mode and SDK sessions, messages sent to a background subagent are no longer silently lost when the subagent is finishing its turn. If the conversation that launched a subagent is compacted before reading the report, the finished subagent's findings will no longer be dropped. Background subagents can now use the LSP tool for semantic code analysis when an LSP plugin is active. Pressing Ctrl+C twice now cleanly exits while background subagents are running, removing the need for three or four presses. Resuming a session with unfinished background agents, shells, or workflows will not start a model turn on its own before you type anything. In addition, expanding subagent hand-back messages outside verbose mode no longer exposes internal provenance preambles.

items.original:
Fixed subagent hand-back messages showing an internal provenance preamble when expanded outside verbose mode
Fixed resuming a session with unfinished background agents, shells or workflows starting a model turn on its own before you typed anything
Fixed messages sent to a background subagent being silently lost in headless and SDK sessions when the subagent was finishing its turn
Fixed a finished subagent's report being lost when the conversation that launched it was compacted before the report was read
Fixed background subagents being unable to use the LSP tool when an LSP plugin is active
Fixed Ctrl+C needing three or four presses to exit while background subagents are running; two presses now exit

title.zh-TW: 背景任務不再把正常結果誤報成失敗
title.en: Background tasks stop reporting normal results as failures

body.zh-TW: 背景任務遇到小狀況時，現在不會再亂報失敗或卡在空白畫面。背景 shell 任務回傳良性的非零退出碼（例如未找到匹配項的 grep 指令）時，不再被誤報為執行失敗。當傳入工作階段的環境變數中包含空字元時，背景工作階段 `claude --bg` 現在依然能正常執行 Git、掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）、外掛與其他輔助程式。當暫存目錄已滿、沒有寫入權限或屬於其他使用者時，執行 `claude agents` 會顯示明確的錯誤訊息，不再停留在無回應的空白畫面。跨工作階段通訊的啟動警告也做了說明改進，清楚指出可以使用 `--debug-file` 將除錯日誌寫入你指定的檔案路徑。
body.en: When background tasks hit minor snags, they no longer report false failures or sit on a blank screen. When background shell tasks return benign non-zero exit codes (such as a grep command finding no matches), they are no longer reported as failures. When environment variables passed into a session contain NUL characters, background sessions running `claude --bg` can still execute Git, hooks, plugins, and helper programs normally. When the temp directory is full, lacks write permissions, or is owned by another user, running `claude agents` displays a clear error message instead of remaining stuck on a blank, unresponsive screen. Startup warnings for cross-session messaging have also been improved to explain that `--debug-file` writes debug logs to a path you choose.

items.original:
Fixed background shell tasks reporting benign non-zero exits (e.g. grep with no matches) as failures
Fixed background sessions (`claude --bg`) being unable to run git, hooks, plugins and other helper programs when an environment variable handed to the session contained a NUL character
Fixed `claude agents` showing a blank, unresponsive screen instead of an error when the temp directory is full, not writable or owned by another user
Improved the cross-session messaging startup warning to explain that `--debug-file` writes a debug log to a path you choose

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具說明長度可以自己調，重新加回的伺服器直接連上
title.en: MCP description length is now adjustable, and re-added servers reconnect right away

body.zh-TW: 你可以透過新增環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH`，自訂工作階段內所有 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器的工具說明與指示文字長度，打破原先 2,048 個字元的預設限制。另外，以前用 `claude mcp remove` 移除 MCP 伺服器後，若以相同名稱重新新增該伺服器，介面可能會停留在需要認證的錯誤狀態；現在會直接重新連線，不必再手動登入一次。⟦就像便利貼的大小改成由你挑，工具說明不必硬擠在 2,048 字裡；拔掉再插回同一支隨身碟，電腦也會直接認得，不會再叫你重新登入。⟧
body.en: You can now set the environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH` to customize the length cap on MCP tool descriptions and server instructions across every MCP server in the session, overriding the default 2,048-character limit. In addition, when an MCP server was re-added under the same name after running `claude mcp remove`, the interface previously remained stuck in an error state requiring authentication; the system now reconnects directly without requiring repetitive manual sign-ins. ⟦Think of it as picking your own sticky-note size, so tool descriptions no longer have to squeeze into 2,048 characters; and plugging the same USB stick back in gets recognized right away instead of asking you to sign in again.⟧

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH` to change the 2,048-character cap on MCP tool descriptions and server instructions for every MCP server in the session
Fixed an MCP server re-added under the same name after `claude mcp remove` still showing as needing authentication instead of reconnecting

title.zh-TW: Artifact 發布出問題會說明原因，網頁深色模式也補齊
title.en: Artifact publishing explains what went wrong, and dark mode now covers the whole page

body.zh-TW: 用 Claude 發布 Artifact 時，出了問題現在會先講清楚，不再悄悄失敗。當組織政策因網路代理等因素無法載入時，Artifact 工具不再悄悄消失，Claude 現在會具體說明受阻原因。當重新發布 Artifact 時若遺漏了資料庫存取規則或檢視者個人檔案範圍，Claude 會直接拒絕發布，避免儲存的存取規則被意外重設或範圍遺失。當 Claude 無法讀取收到的 Artifact 連結時，會在繼續之前先告訴你。產出的 Artifact 網頁拿掉了列印按鈕、確認對話框以及檢視器阻擋的裝置功能，電子郵件與電話改以純文字呈現，深色模式也完整套用至表單控制項與捲軸。
body.en: When you publish an Artifact with Claude, problems now get explained up front instead of failing quietly. When organization policies fail to load due to factors like web proxies, the Artifact tool no longer disappears silently; Claude now explicitly explains what is blocking it. When republishing an artifact, if database access rules or viewer profile scopes are omitted, the system actively refuses publication, preventing stored access rules from being accidentally reset or scopes from being dropped. If Claude cannot read an artifact link it received, it notifies the user before continuing. For generated artifact web pages, Print buttons, confirmation dialogs, and device features blocked by the viewer have been removed, email and phone details appear as plain text, and dark mode extends across form controls and scrollbars.

items.original:
Fixed the Artifact tool silently disappearing when your organization's policy can't be loaded (for example behind a web proxy); Claude now says what's blocking it
Fixed artifact republishes silently resetting stored database access rules or dropping the viewer profile scope when that capability was re-sent without them; they are now refused
Improved the Artifact tool so that when Claude cannot read an artifact link it was given, it tells the user before continuing
Improved artifact pages: no Print buttons, confirm dialogs or device features the viewer blocks, email and phone details shown as text, and dark mode that reaches form controls and scrollbars

title.zh-TW: 雲端審查不再上傳金鑰副本，遠端工作階段的幾個中斷修好了
title.en: Cloud reviews keep key copies local, and several remote session interruptions are fixed

body.zh-TW: 在雲端跑審查、遠端操控工作階段的人，這批修正少了很多意外中斷。使用 `/ultrareview` 上傳審查時，金鑰與設定檔複本（如 `id_rsa copy` 或 `kubeconfig (1).yaml`）留在本機不上傳。若工作階段被刪除或帳號變更，`/ultrareview` 不再誤報已停止的審查，也不會死等至逾時。在 Claude 應用程式中，遠端操控與雲端工作階段在 `/compact` 或 `/clear` 後上下文用量即時更新；當分支同時有已提交與未提交變更時，diff 檢視不再遺漏已提交檔案。伺服器過載且存取 token（授權令牌）輪替時，雲端與自架 runner 不再因認證失敗中斷。Cowork 編輯逾 10,800 字元記憶體衝突時，重試寫入不再丟失中段內容。
body.en: If you run reviews in the cloud or drive sessions remotely, this batch removes several surprise interruptions. When uploading reviews with `/ultrareview`, renamed copies of key and config files (such as `id_rsa copy` or `kubeconfig (1).yaml`) remain on your local machine rather than being uploaded. If a session is deleted or the signed-in account changes, `/ultrareview` no longer misreports stopped reviews as completed or retriable errors, nor does it wait out the full timeout. In the Claude app, context usage figures for Remote Control and cloud sessions update immediately after `/compact` or `/clear`; when a branch has both committed and uncommitted changes, the diff view no longer drops committed files. When servers experience prolonged overloads during which access tokens rotate, cloud and self-hosted runner sessions no longer fail with authentication errors. When memory write conflicts arise in Cowork sessions for files exceeding about 10,800 characters, retried writes no longer drop the middle content.

items.original:
Fixed `/ultrareview` reporting a stopped cloud review as completed or as an error to retry, and waiting out the full timeout when its session was deleted or the signed-in account changed
Fixed the Claude app showing a missing or stale context usage figure for Remote Control and cloud sessions right after /compact or /clear
Fixed the Claude app's diff view for Remote Control and cloud sessions dropping a branch's committed files whenever there are also uncommitted changes
Fixed cloud and self-hosted runner sessions failing with "Authentication failed" after waiting out a long overload during which the session's access token was rotated
Fixed memory write conflicts in Cowork sessions showing Claude only the start and end of a memory file over about 10,800 characters, so the retried write dropped the middle
Improved `/ultrareview` uploads: renamed copies of key files, such as `id_rsa copy` or `kubeconfig (1).yaml`, now also stay on your machine

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤逾時會指名是哪一個，日誌也記下輸出大小
title.en: Hook timeouts name the culprit, and logs record output size

body.zh-TW: 自己寫掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）的人，出問題時更好查了。OpenTelemetry 的 `hook_execution_complete` 事件中新增了掛鉤輸出大小，以及因超出限制而存入檔案的超大輸出數量記錄。當 `UserPromptSubmit` 掛鉤執行逾時，逾時提示訊息與除錯日誌中現在會具體指出是哪一個掛鉤指令發生逾時。在 `PermissionRequest` 掛鉤中，代理型別（agent-type）的掛鉤因無法做出允許或拒絕的判定而不再允許執行，介面會顯示錯誤並引導你改用指令型或 HTTP 型掛鉤。
body.en: If you write your own hooks, problems are now easier to track down. The `hook_execution_complete` OpenTelemetry event now includes hook output sizes and the count of oversized outputs saved to disk. When a `UserPromptSubmit` hook times out, the timeout notice and debug log now explicitly name which hook command timed out. In addition, agent-type hooks are no longer permitted in `PermissionRequest` hooks since their answers could never allow or deny requests; the interface now displays an error pointing to command or HTTP hooks.

items.original:
Added hook output sizes and the number of oversized outputs saved to a file to the `hook_execution_complete` OpenTelemetry event
Improved the UserPromptSubmit hook timeout notice and the debug log to name which hook command timed out
Changed `PermissionRequest` hooks: an agent-type hook no longer runs there, since its answer could never allow or deny the request; it now shows an error pointing to command or http hooks

title.zh-TW: 權限規則清單更好操作，刪除確認預設改成 No
title.en: The permission rules list is easier to use, and delete confirmations default to No

body.zh-TW: 權限規則一多、清單一長，最容易迷失的是游標停在哪裡。在 `/permissions` 中檢視、新增或刪除規則後，介面焦點會自動回到規則清單中，刪除規則與移除目錄的確認對話框預設選項也改為 No 以防止手滑誤刪；在規則清單中按下 `←`、`→` 與 Tab 鍵可直接切換分頁，無需將焦點移至分頁列。執行 `/install-github-app` 進行 GitHub CLI 檢查與儲存庫選取步驟時，畫面現在會顯示「按 Esc 取消」的提示。`/artifacts` 與 `/workflows` 清單右側新增了捲軸，方便看清長清單的隱藏範圍與目前所在位置。工作流程進度樹中正在執行的代理與階段圖示從 `⟳` 改為暗色圓點。
body.en: Once permission rules pile up and lists grow long, the easiest thing to lose track of is where your cursor sits. After viewing, adding, or deleting a rule in `/permissions`, focus returns to the rule list automatically, and confirmation dialogs for deleting rules or removing directories now default to No to prevent accidental deletions. Pressing `←`, `→`, and Tab within the rule list switches tabs directly without moving focus to the tab bar. Running `/install-github-app` now displays "Esc to cancel" during the GitHub CLI check and repository selection steps. Scrollbars at the right edge of `/artifacts` and `/workflows` lists make it easy to see how much of a long list is hidden and where you currently are. In addition, running agents and phases in the workflow progress tree now display a dim dot instead of `⟳`.

items.original:
Improved `/permissions`: focus returns to the rule list after viewing, adding or deleting a rule, and the delete-rule and remove-directory confirmations now default to No
Improved `/permissions` tab navigation: ←/→ and Tab pressed in a rule list now switch tabs without moving focus to the tab bar
Improved `/install-github-app`: the GitHub CLI check and repository selection steps now show "Esc to cancel"
Improved the `/artifacts` and `/workflows` lists: a scrollbar at the right edge shows how much of a long list is hidden and where you are in it
Improved the workflow progress tree: running agents and phases now show a dim dot instead of ⟳

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕排版對齊，打 @ 找檔案先列檔名相符的
title.en: Fullscreen layouts line up, and @ file search lists filename matches first

body.zh-TW: 全螢幕畫面的排版、程式碼顏色和找檔案的排序，各修了一點。在全螢幕模式下，`/plugin` 的新增市集表單不再於窗格內額外繪製方框，文字與按鍵提示與其餘介面完全對齊；`/workflows` 詳細檢視畫面在全螢幕下也不會在窗格分隔線下方繪製多餘的第二條水平分隔線。未指定語言的程式碼區塊現在會採用類似行內程式碼的顏色標註，使指令能從周圍文字中清楚凸顯。當你在工具仍在執行時透過 `/btw` 提出旁支問題，Claude Code 現在認得這個呼叫還在跑，不會將其誤判為失敗呼叫。在輸入 `@` 搜尋檔案時，檔案名稱直接符合搜尋詞的項目現在會優先排在僅資料夾名稱符合的項目之前。
body.en: Fullscreen layout, code colors, and file search ranking each got a small fix. In fullscreen mode, the Add Marketplace form in `/plugin` no longer draws an extra box inside the pane, aligning its text and key hints with the rest of the interface. The `/workflows` detail view in fullscreen mode no longer draws an extra horizontal line beneath the pane divider. Code blocks without a specified language are now styled with inline-code coloring so commands stand out distinctly from surrounding text. Asking side questions via `/btw` while a tool is still running now recognizes the call as in progress rather than misinterpreting it as failed. When searching files with `@`, entries matching the query in their file name rank above those matching only across folder names.

items.original:
Improved `/plugin`'s Add Marketplace form in fullscreen: it no longer draws a box inside the pane, and its text and key hints line up with the rest of `/plugin`
Improved the `/workflows` detail view in fullscreen: it no longer draws a second horizontal rule under the pane's divider
Improved code blocks that don't name a language: they are now colored like inline code, so commands stand out from the surrounding text
Improved `/btw` asked while a tool is still running: the side question now knows that call is in progress instead of reading it as a failed one
Improved `@` file suggestions: a file whose name contains the query now ranks above one that only matches across its folder names

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器收尾更穩，Windows 清理不再誤刪捷徑
title.en: Self-hosted runners shut down cleanly, and Windows cleanup stops deleting shortcuts

body.zh-TW: 自架執行器（在你自己機器上替 Claude Code 跑工作的程式）和 Windows 使用者，這批修正讓收尾和清理更可靠。在 self-hosted runner 中，生命週期掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）提交在 `--configure-git` 下無法簽章已修復。執行器達到 `--retire-at` 即將退役時，會等待該輪對話回報完畢再停止工作階段，避免遺失信號。生命週期掛鉤中的 Git 忽略執行器共用 Git 檔案指定的目錄與程式，本機路徑與 `git://` 遠端現在需要設定 `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL`。Windows 背景清理不再誤刪用於重定向 `~/.claude/session-env`、`image-cache` 等目標的目錄符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）或接合點。
body.en: For self-hosted runners and Windows users, this batch makes shutdown and cleanup more dependable. On self-hosted runners, lifecycle-hook commits failing to sign under `--configure-git` has been resolved. When a runner reaches `--retire-at` and is about to retire, it briefly waits for the turn to be reported before stopping the session, avoiding lost finish signals. Git inside lifecycle hooks now ignores hook directories and programs named in the runner's shared Git files, while local-path and `git://` remotes now require `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL`. On Windows, background cleanup no longer deletes directory symlinks or junctions used to relocate `~/.claude/session-env`, `image-cache`, or other target directories.

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed lifecycle-hook commits failing to sign under `--configure-git`
Windows: Fixed background cleanup deleting a directory symlink or junction used to relocate `~/.claude/session-env`, `image-cache` or another cleaned-up folder
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a turn that ended right at a `--retire-at` release losing its finished signal; the runner now briefly waits for the turn to be reported before stopping the session
Self-hosted runner: Changed git in lifecycle hooks to ignore hook folders and programs named in the runner's shared git files; local-path and `git://` remotes there now need `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL`

title.zh-TW: VS Code 多了六個斜線指令對話框
title.en: VS Code gains six slash-command dialogs

body.zh-TW: VS Code 使用者這次拿到一批新對話框。你現在可以在對話框輸入 `/status` 開啟狀態對話框，檢視工作階段的版本、帳號、模型與伺服器詳細資訊；輸入 `/sandbox` 或從面板選單開啟沙盒對話框，管理沙盒模式、非沙盒備援與排除指令；輸入 `/chrome` 開啟 Claude in Chrome 對話框，查看擴充功能狀態、安裝、重新連線、權限頁面與預設啟用設定。輸入 `/export` 可將對話複製或儲存為純文字；輸入 `/skills` 開啟 Slash 指令對話框，能查看各個技能的來源、預估 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量與啟用狀態，並可直接點擊切換；輸入 `/plan` 則可切換至計畫模式、發送第一個計畫提示詞或查看目前計畫。
body.en: VS Code users get a batch of new dialogs this time. You can type `/status` to open the Status dialog, inspecting session version, account, model, and server details. You can type `/sandbox` or open the Sandbox dialog from the panel menu to manage sandbox mode, unsandboxed fallbacks, and excluded commands. You can type `/chrome` or open the Claude in Chrome dialog from the panel menu to view extension status, installation, reconnection, permissions pages, and the enabled-by-default setting. In addition, typing `/export` copies or saves the conversation as plain text. Typing `/skills` opens the Slash commands dialog to check each skill's source, token estimate, and on/off state with click-to-toggle support. Typing `/plan` switches to plan mode, sends a first planning prompt, or views the current plan.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a Status dialog, with a typed `/status`, showing the session's version, account, model and server details
[VSCode] Added a Sandbox dialog for the sandbox mode, the unsandboxed fallback and excluded commands, opened from the panel menu or by typing `/sandbox`
[VSCode] Added a Claude in Chrome dialog (extension status, the install, reconnect and permissions pages, the enabled-by-default setting), opened from the panel menu or by typing `/chrome`
[VSCode] Added Export conversation, with a typed `/export`, to copy or save the conversation as plain text
[VSCode] Added each skill's source, token estimate and on/off state to the Slash commands dialog, with a click to change the state, and a typed `/skills` that opens it
[VSCode] Added a typed `/plan` that switches to plan mode, sends a first planning prompt, or shows the session's plan

title.zh-TW: VS Code 貼上長文字會自動標記，新分頁開在旁邊
title.en: VS Code marks long pastes, and new tabs open beside your editor

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 貼上一大段文字時，Claude 現在分得出哪些是貼的、哪些是你打的。在聊天輸入框中貼上超過 800 個字元或包含超過 2 個換行符號的文字時，會自動標記成貼上內容。貼上文字時若包含不可見的 Unicode 格式化與標籤字元，清掉後會跳提示，其餘文字中的不可見字元也會在發送前自動移除。點擊「在新分頁開啟」時，Claude 視窗現在會直接開啟在你當前編輯器群組的旁邊，不再排在最後一個群組之後。重新開啟工作階段後，你發送的訊息中不再殘留貼上標記線。
body.en: When you paste a big chunk of text in VS Code, Claude can now tell what you pasted from what you typed. When pasting text over 800 characters or containing more than 2 line breaks into the chat box, the text is automatically marked as pasted so Claude can distinguish it from what you typed. If pasted text contains invisible Unicode formatting and tag characters, the system notifies you after stripping them, and invisible characters in any other text are removed before sending. Clicking "Open in New Tab" now opens Claude right beside the editor group you are currently working in rather than after the last group. In addition, paste marker lines no longer linger in your own messages after reopening a session.

items.original:
[VSCode] Improved pasted-text handling in the chat box: a paste over 800 characters or over 2 line breaks is now marked so Claude can tell it from what you typed
[VSCode] Improved prompt handling in the chat box: invisible Unicode formatting and tag characters are removed from pasted text with a notice, and from anything else before it is sent
[VSCode] Changed "Open in New Tab" to open Claude beside the editor group you are working in rather than after the last group
[VSCode] Fixed paste marker lines showing in your own messages after reopening a session

title.zh-TW: VS Code 思考力度即時顯示，Python 擴充套件卡住不再拖累啟動
title.en: VS Code shows live thinking effort, and a stuck Python extension no longer blocks startup

body.zh-TW: VS Code 裡幾個會卡住或顯示錯的地方修好了。思考力度標籤不再顯示過期的儲存數值，改為即時呈現工作階段實際執行的力度等級。當 Python 擴充套件在啟用過程中卡住時，Claude Code 不再永久等待，而是在 60 秒後略過 Python 環境直接啟動。在計畫審批卡片中，當自動模式可用時，第一個選項現在會正常提供「是，並使用自動模式」，與終端機體驗保持一致。從鍵盤封存或取消封存工作階段後，工作階段清單中的方向鍵導覽不會再中斷失效。
body.en: A few spots in VS Code that stalled or showed stale info are fixed. The effort chip no longer shows a stale saved effort level, instead displaying the actual level the session runs at in real time. When the Python extension hangs during activation, Claude Code no longer waits indefinitely, starting after 60 seconds without the Python environment. On the plan approval card, when auto mode is available, the first option now properly offers "Yes, and use auto mode", matching the terminal experience. In addition, arrow-key navigation in the session list no longer stops working after archiving or unarchiving a session from the keyboard.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the effort chip showing a stale saved effort level instead of the level the session runs at
[VSCode] Fixed Claude Code never starting when the Python extension hangs while activating; it now starts after 60 seconds without the Python environment
[VSCode] Fixed the plan approval card never offering auto mode: when auto mode is available, its first option is now "Yes, and use auto mode", as in the terminal
[VSCode] Fixed arrow-key navigation in the session list stopping after archiving or unarchiving a session from the keyboard

title.zh-TW: 例行任務設定搬到 Remote sessions，GitHub Enterprise 權杖自動續期
title.en: Routine settings move under Remote sessions, and GitHub Enterprise tokens renew automatically

body.zh-TW: 在網頁版管理例行任務（排好時間自動跑的工作）的人，設定位置和續跑方式都有調整。管理員的例行任務開關設定已移至「Admin settings → Capabilities → Remote sessions」路徑下，Claude Code 管理頁面也附上了跳轉連結。在 GitHub Enterprise Server 儲存庫的雲端工作階段中執行 `gh` 指令與 GitHub API 呼叫時，存取 token（授權令牌）在約八小時後會自動續約，不再發生逾期中斷。若在排程執行前一刻編輯了例行任務，復原既有工作階段時會立即採用最新的提示詞與名稱，不再沿用舊設定執行。
body.en: If you manage routines on the web, where they live in settings and how they keep running have changed. The admin Routines on/off setting has moved under "Admin settings → Capabilities → Remote sessions", with a direct link added to the Claude Code admin page. When executing `gh` commands and GitHub API calls inside a cloud session on a GitHub Enterprise Server repository, access tokens renew automatically after about eight hours without expiring. In addition, if a routine is edited moments before its scheduled execution, resuming an existing session immediately applies the updated prompt and name rather than running with old settings.

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Changed the admin Routines on/off setting to live under Admin settings → Capabilities → Remote sessions; the Claude Code admin page now links to it
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed `gh` and GitHub API calls inside a cloud session on a GitHub Enterprise Server repository failing after about eight hours; the token now renews automatically
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed a routine that resumes an existing session running with its old prompt and name when it was edited moments before the scheduled run started

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段打不開的檔案會說明原因，過期審批不再算你拒絕
title.en: Cloud sessions explain files they can't open, and expired approvals no longer count as your denial

body.zh-TW: 在網頁版用雲端工作階段時，遇到打不開的檔案或過期的審批，現在會講清楚。在雲端工作階段轉錄紀錄中，指向工作目錄以外的檔案連結若無法載入，現在會直接停用並明確說明原因，不再打開永遠載入中的空白檔案卡片。在自動模式下，若審批提示逾期未回覆或被新訊息取代，不再記成你主動拒絕，工具呼叫能正常進行後續重試。在 Claude 應用程式中檢視雲端工作階段時，Claude 現在會將專供你使用的檔案儲存在應用程式可開啟的位置。在管理員關閉 GitHub 的組織中於自架環境啟動工作階段時，介面不再顯示空的儲存庫選擇器。
body.en: In cloud sessions on the web, unreachable files and expired approvals are now explained clearly. In cloud session transcripts, file links pointing outside the working directory that fail to load are now disabled with an explanation, rather than opening a blank file card that never loads. In auto mode, if an approval prompt expires unanswered or is superseded by a newer message, it is no longer recorded as an active user rejection, allowing tool calls to retry normally. When viewing cloud sessions in the Claude app, Claude now saves files intended for you where the app can open them. In addition, starting a session on a self-hosted environment in an organization where an admin turned GitHub off no longer shows an empty repository picker.

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed file links in a cloud session transcript that point outside the session's working directory opening a file card that never loads; they're now disabled and say why
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed auto mode refusing to retry a tool call because an approval prompt that expired unanswered, or was superseded by a newer message, had been recorded as your rejection
[Claude Code on the web] Improved cloud sessions viewed in the Claude app: Claude now saves files meant for you where the app can open them
[Claude Code on the web] Removed the empty repository picker shown when starting a session on a self-hosted environment in an organization where an admin has turned GitHub off

title.zh-TW: Slack 裡看得到 Claude 做到哪，也能隨時按停
title.en: See Claude's progress in Slack and stop it anytime

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 頻道把工作丟給 Claude 之後，你會想知道它做到哪了。Claude 在頻道討論串中回覆時，會顯示 Slack 原生的運作指示器、中斷按鈕與討論串標題；運作指示器會持續顯示直到任務完成，按下中斷按鈕可隨時中止執行。在訪客限制或僅限頻道設定下，當訪客加入或最後一名訪客離開而改變了 Claude 的回應方式時，頻道內會發出簡短通知說明變更。對於在加入 Enterprise Grid 之前就已連接 Claude 的 Slack 工作區，排程例行任務無聲失敗的問題已修復。
body.en: Once you hand work to Claude in a Slack channel, you want to know how far along it is. When Claude replies in channel threads, it displays Slack's native Working indicator, Stop button, and thread title; the indicator remains visible until Claude finishes, and pressing Stop interrupts the task at any time. Under Restrict or Channel only guest settings, when a guest joins or the last guest leaves and alters how Claude responds, a short notice is posted in the channel explaining the change. In addition, scheduled routines failing silently in Slack workspaces connected to Claude before joining Enterprise Grid have been fixed.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added Slack's native Working indicator, Stop button and thread title to Claude's threads in channels; the indicator stays up until Claude finishes, and Stop interrupts the task
[Claude Tag] Added a short notice in the Slack channel when a guest joining, or the last guest leaving, changes how Claude responds there under a Restrict or Channel only guest setting
[Claude Tag] Fixed scheduled routines silently failing to run in Slack workspaces that were connected to Claude before the workspace joined its Enterprise Grid

title.zh-TW: Slack 檔案掃描會自動重試，錯誤訊息講出具體原因
title.en: Slack file scans retry automatically, and errors say what actually failed

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 用 Claude 遇到錯誤時，現在比較知道是哪裡出問題。當遇到短暫的檔案掃描服務中斷時，Claude 不再要求你重新上傳檔案，而是會自動重試掃描並在掃描器離線時接收通知。在 Claude 的 Slack 回覆中，開頭帶有 `+`、`-` 或 `*` 符號的項目清單不再被錯誤渲染為空白項目符號與多餘的巢狀項目，文字內容與開頭符號完整保留為單一項目符號。當雲端環境設定指令碼執行失敗時，通知訊息不再僅顯示通用的重試提示，改為具體指出失敗的指令碼名稱並提示先修復問題。在管理員設定中，GitHub 連線橫幅現在會詳細說明未連線的具體原因，包括未登入、應用程式未連結或未安裝、登入逾期或 SSO 未授權。
body.en: When something goes wrong using Claude in Slack, it's now clearer where the problem is. When a brief file-scanning service outage occurs, Claude no longer asks you to re-upload files, instead retrying the scan automatically and receiving a notice if the scanner is down. In Claude's Slack replies, list items starting with `+`, `-`, or `*` are no longer rendered as empty bullets with stray nested items, properly preserving the text and character as a single bullet. When cloud environment setup scripts fail, the notice no longer displays a generic retry prompt, instead naming the failed script and advising you to fix the issue first. In admin settings, the GitHub connection banner now explains exact disconnection reasons, including not signed in, app not linked or not installed, sign-in expired, or SSO not authorized.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude asking you to re-upload a Slack file when a brief file-scanning outage, not the file, was the problem; it now retries the scan and is told when the scanner is down
[Claude Tag] Fixed a bullet in Claude's Slack reply whose text starts with +, - or * rendering as an empty bullet with a stray nested item; it now shows as one bullet with the character kept
[Claude Tag] Fixed the Slack notice for a failed cloud environment setup script sometimes being a generic "mention me to retry"; it now names the setup script and says to fix it first
[Claude Tag] Improved the GitHub banner in Claude Tag admin settings to say why GitHub isn't connected: not signed in, app not linked or not installed, sign-in expired, or SSO not authorized

title.zh-TW: REVIEW.md 太長被截掉時，Code Review 會告訴你
title.en: Code Review now tells you when REVIEW.md is too long and gets cut

body.zh-TW: 審查規範寫得太長，有一部分可能根本沒被讀到。當儲存庫中的 `REVIEW.md` 審查指示檔案因為超過大小限制而在程式碼審查過程中遭到部分裁切或完全忽略時，Code Review 檢查執行會明確發出通知，具體指出檔案名稱與大小限制上限。團隊看到就知道規範沒有完全生效，可以回頭調整檔案長度。⟦交稿給編輯時，稿子太長被砍掉一部分，以前編輯不會吭聲；現在會在稿子上註明砍到哪、上限是多少。⟧
body.en: If your review guidelines run long, part of them may never have been read at all. When a repository's `REVIEW.md` instruction file is partially cut or entirely omitted during code review because it exceeds size limits, the Code Review check run explicitly issues a notice naming the file and the exact limit. This allows teams to immediately understand why review guidelines did not take full effect and adjust instruction file lengths promptly. ⟦It's like handing an editor a manuscript that runs long: part of it used to get cut without a word, and now the editor notes what was cut and what the limit is.⟧

items.original: [Code Review] Improved the Code Review check run to say when REVIEW.md instructions were cut or left out of a review for exceeding a size limit, naming the file and the limit

title.zh-TW: 自動模式改採伺服器端分類器，省下額外判斷開銷
title.en: Auto mode switches to server-side classifier, saving extra evaluation overhead

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 Claude 在自動模式下處理任務時，現在不必再為背後的判斷多付一筆開銷。⟦這好比無人停車場的車牌辨識，進出時由遠端主機驗證放行且免收手續費，只有切換到人工備援窗口時才會提醒加收費用。⟧針對 Claude API、Enterprise 用戶，以及 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 與各大閘道，自動模式已改為預設啟用伺服器端分類器。此機制不收取分類器的額外開銷；若退回計費的備援流程，系統會主動發出警告。只要輸入 `/status` 指令，即可在新增的 `Auto mode server` 資料列查看目前工作階段是否在伺服器端運行。若在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 或閘道端想退出，將環境變數設為 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` 即可。
body.en: When letting Claude handle tasks in auto mode, you no longer need to pay extra overhead for the underlying evaluations. ⟦It is like license plate recognition at an automated parking lot, where entry and exit are verified and cleared by a remote host with no processing fee, and extra charges are alerted only when switching to a manual fallback booth.⟧ For Claude API and Enterprise users, as well as Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and major gateways, auto mode now defaults to enabling the server-side classifier. This mechanism does not charge for classifier overhead, and the system actively warns if it falls back to a billed process. Simply run the `/status` command to check whether the current session is running on the server in the newly added `Auto mode server` row. To opt out on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or gateways, simply set the environment variable to `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0`.

items.original:
Changed auto mode for Claude API and Enterprise users, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways, to default to the server-side classifier, which does not charge for classifier overhead (`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` opts out on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways); warns on billed fallback. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing
Added an `Auto mode server` row to `/status` showing whether this session's auto mode classifier runs on the server

title.zh-TW: 專案指示新增 AGENTS.md 支援，無專屬設定時自動代入
title.en: Added AGENTS.md Support for Project Instructions, Automatically Loaded When No Custom File Exists

body.zh-TW: 當你接手遵循通用標準的專案時，只要根目錄中沒有 `CLAUDE.md`，Claude Code 現在會自動讀取 `AGENTS.md` 作為指引。⟦這就像巡邏員查訪住戶，若門口沒貼專屬公告，便主動借閱通用的社區規章。⟧ 你可以在 `/config` 的「Project instructions」項目下自訂要讀取的指示檔案。這項功能目前尚未套用至 Bedrock、Vertex 或 Foundry 平台。
body.en: When working on projects following common standards, Claude Code now automatically reads `AGENTS.md` as guidance whenever there is no `CLAUDE.md` in the root directory. ⟦This is like a patrol officer visiting a residence: if no custom notice is posted on the door, they consult the standard community guidelines instead.⟧ You can customize the instruction file to read under "Project instructions" in `/config`. This feature is not yet available on Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry.

items.original: Added AGENTS.md support: in a project with no CLAUDE.md, Claude Code reads AGENTS.md instead; change it under "Project instructions" in `/config` (not yet on Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry)

title.zh-TW: 應用網關轉發代理強化，支援自訂標頭並改由代理解析主機名稱
title.en: Enhanced Forward Proxy Support for App Gateways, Adding Custom Headers and Proxy-Side Hostname Resolution

body.zh-TW: 針對僅透過正向代理連線的企業應用網關，現在可設定 `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_PROXY_IS_EGRESS_BOUNDARY=1`，讓所有對外請求直接交由代理伺服器解析主機名稱，不再於本機自行解析。上游配置新增選填的 `headers:` 對應表，可向模型供應商前端的自建代理傳送靜態標頭。設定代理時，遙測（telemetry，收集軟體運作數據以利分析的機制）轉發器不再忽略 `NO_PROXY` 名單中的主機或網域。本機回送連線錯誤訊息現在會明確提示設定 `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_ALLOW_LOOPBACK`。⟦這好比跨國企業的郵務總收發處，所有對外信件直接將收件地址交給專屬外務快遞分揀，內部公文則依照豁免清單直送特定部門。⟧
body.en: For enterprise Claude apps gateways whose only egress is a forward proxy, setting `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_PROXY_IS_EGRESS_BOUNDARY=1` now hands the proxy the hostname for every outbound request instead of resolving it locally. An optional `headers:` map has been added to upstream configurations to send static headers to a custom proxy running in front of a provider. When a proxy is configured, the telemetry relay no longer ignores collector hosts or domains listed in `NO_PROXY`. Loopback connection error messages now clearly suggest setting `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_ALLOW_LOOPBACK`. ⟦This is like a multinational corporation's central mailroom: all outbound mail passes addresses directly to dedicated external couriers for sorting, while internal documents are routed directly to specific departments according to an exemption list.⟧

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_PROXY_IS_EGRESS_BOUNDARY=1` for Claude apps gateways whose only egress is a forward proxy: every outbound request hands the proxy the hostname instead of resolving it locally
Added an optional `headers:` map on Claude apps gateway upstreams, to send static headers to a proxy you run in front of a provider
Fixed the Claude apps gateway's telemetry relay ignoring a collector hostname or domain listed in `NO_PROXY` when a proxy is set
Improved the Claude apps gateway's loopback error messages to name `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_ALLOW_LOOPBACK`

title.zh-TW: 背景任務即時提示更新，工作階段不再因語言伺服器中斷
title.en: Real-Time Background Task Update Notices, Preventing Session Crashes from Language Server Exits

body.zh-TW: 檢視執行進度時，若背景任務在此期間處理完畢，`/tasks` 等面板會即時出現提示行，告知有等待檢視的最新進展。以 `claude --bg` 啟動的背景工作階段，不再因為外掛的語言伺服器（LSP，在背景分析程式碼語法的輔助工具）結束或關閉標準輸入而異常退出。舊版的 `TaskOutput` 工具已正式移除，Claude 改用 `Read` 工具讀取背景任務輸出檔，`taskOutputMaxChars` 設定與 `TASK_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH` 環境變數不再生效。⟦這如同後台的廚房出餐通知燈，當外場翻閱點餐板時若有新菜餚出爐會即刻亮燈，打烊清理部分餐盤也不會影響前台營業。⟧
body.en: When checking task progress, panels such as `/tasks` now display a line notifying you that an update is waiting if a background task finishes while the panel is open. Background sessions started with `claude --bg` no longer unexpectedly exit when a plugin's LSP server exits or closes its stdin. The deprecated `TaskOutput` tool has been officially removed; Claude now reads background task output files using the `Read` tool, and the `taskOutputMaxChars` setting along with the `TASK_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH` environment variable no longer have any effect. ⟦This is like a kitchen order notification light: if a new dish is ready while the front staff is reviewing order boards, it lights up immediately, and clearing away dirty plates in the back does not interrupt front-of-house operations.⟧

items.original:
Added a line saying a background task's update is waiting when it finishes while a panel such as `/tasks` is open
Fixed background sessions (`claude --bg`) exiting when a plugin's LSP server exited or closed its stdin
Removed the deprecated TaskOutput tool; Claude reads a background task's output file with Read instead, and the `taskOutputMaxChars` setting and `TASK_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH` no longer have any effect

title.zh-TW: 無頭工作階段錯誤即時退出，啟動加速且精準累計費用
title.en: Immediate Error Exits for Headless Sessions, Accelerating Startup and Accurately Accumulating Costs

body.zh-TW: 透過自動化腳本或 SDK 呼叫時，在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）下的工作階段若遭遇內部錯誤，不再無限期卡住，現在會清楚回報錯誤並以狀態代碼 1 退出。接續執行先前的工作階段時，花費用量與權杖計量不再從零起算，無頭工作階段會在結束時妥善儲存總計數據。SDK 與無頭模式的首輪對話不再等待逐層搜尋目錄下的 `CLAUDE.md`，加快了啟動速度。在 SDK 或 IDE 之外單獨執行的 `claude -p` 移除了背景生成標題的 Haiku 請求。⟦這就像自動化物流傳送帶，一旦分揀模組故障便立即亮紅燈停機報錯，重新啟動時也會忠實累加已搬運的貨物重量。⟧
body.en: When invoked via automated scripts or the SDK, sessions in headless mode no longer hang indefinitely after encountering an internal error; they now clearly report the error and exit with status code 1. Resuming earlier sessions no longer resets cost and token usage totals to zero, as headless sessions properly save their cumulative totals at exit. The first turn in SDK and headless modes no longer waits on per-directory lookups for `CLAUDE.md`, speeding up startup. Standalone `claude -p` runs outside an SDK or IDE have removed the background Haiku auto-title request. ⟦This is like an automated logistics conveyor belt: if a sorting module malfunctions, it immediately flashes a red light, halts, and reports an error, while restarting faithfully accumulates the weight of previously transported goods.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions that could hang with no result after an internal error; they now report the error and exit with code 1
Fixed a headless resume (`claude -p --resume`, the SDK, a VS Code extension window reload) starting the session's cost and usage totals at zero; headless sessions now save their totals at exit
Improved session start-up for SDK and headless (`-p`) use: the first turn no longer waits on the per-directory CLAUDE.md lookup
Removed the background Haiku auto-title request from `claude -p` runs launched outside an SDK or IDE

title.zh-TW: 子代理結果清晰標註縮排，協同快取與訊息排序修復
title.en: Subagent Results Clearly Indented Under Headers, Fixing Collaborative Caching and Message Ordering

body.zh-TW: 多個代理同時協同分工時，子代理的執行結果現在會加上專屬標題與縮排後傳回主工作階段，避免回傳內容被誤認為主對話的指令。接續執行的子代理與隊友不再重新渲染已載入的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）定義。這項改進妥善保護了快取（暫存提示詞以加快反應）機制。對話中途抵達的代理訊息會精準顯示在抵達位置，而非排在指令列下方。在 `claude agents` 指令中快速輸入不再產生亂碼。代理面板中按下 Enter 鍵能正常選取。雲端工作流程中的腳本提示詞現在明確標註來源。⟦這好比跨部門專案會議，外派助理的調查報告均附上專用簽呈封套並縮排記錄，既不會與主持人的議程混淆，也保留了既有的會議記錄。⟧
body.en: When collaborating across multiple agents, subagent results are now returned to the main agent under a dedicated header with indented formatting, preventing output from being mistaken for the session's own instructions. Resumed subagents and teammates no longer re-render loaded MCP definitions, preserving the prompt caching mechanism. Agent messages arriving mid-turn now appear precisely where they arrived rather than below the command execution row. Fast typing or pasting in `claude agents` dispatch input no longer produces scrambled text. Pressing Enter on a selected agent panel row now functions properly. Script-computed prompts in cloud workflows are now clearly framed with their source. ⟦This is like a cross-departmental project meeting: field assistants' investigation reports are submitted in dedicated covers with indented records, ensuring they are not confused with the host's agenda while preserving existing meeting minutes.⟧

items.original:
Fixed messages from other agents (such as a subagent's SendMessage) that arrived mid-turn showing up below the "Ran N shell commands" row instead of where they arrived
Fixed typed or pasted text occasionally coming out scrambled in the `claude agents` dispatch input during key repeat or very fast input
Fixed Enter on a selected agent panel row doing nothing when `keybindings.json` rebinds Enter in the Chat context, for example to `chat:queueSubmit`
Fixed resumed subagents and teammates re-rendering the MCP tool definitions they had loaded, which broke prompt caching for that agent
Changed subagent results to reach the main agent under a header marking them as subagent output, with the result indented, so text in a subagent's result cannot pass as the session's own instructions
Changed workflow scripts' computed `agent()` prompts on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to reach the subagent framed as script-authored text, so the safety classifier does not read them as the user

title.zh-TW: 外掛安裝防損毀，市集版本精確記錄並支援更新提示
title.en: Plugin Installation Corruption Prevention, Accurately Recording Marketplace Versions with Update Prompts

body.zh-TW: 管理擴充套件時，執行 `claude plugin install` 重新安裝正在被某個工作階段或其他程式使用的外掛版本，若版本未變更會保留原樣，不再損毀已安裝的副本；若市集有新版本，指令會主動提示並建議改用 `claude plugin update`。官方市集安裝的外掛現在會在 `installed_plugins.json` 中正確記錄 Git 提交雜湊，更新固定版本的套件時也會同步刷新紀錄。企業市集規則中若存在格式錯誤的項目，系統不再默默關閉整套市集控管策略。外掛重載預覽不再於結束前持續佔用解壓暫存檔，也不會覆寫備援下載快取（暫存安裝檔的空間）。⟦這就像圖書館的館藏維護，讀者正在借閱的圖書若無修訂版就原地保留，採購清單中少數有誤的書目也不會導致全館進書政策停擺。⟧
body.en: When managing extensions, running `claude plugin install` to reinstall a plugin version currently in use by a session or another program leaves unchanged copies alone instead of corrupting the installed copy; if a newer version exists in the marketplace, the command now proactively notifies you and suggests `claude plugin update`. Plugins installed from the official marketplace now correctly record their Git commit hash in `installed_plugins.json`, and updating a pinned-commit plugin updates this record accordingly. A malformed entry in enterprise marketplace rules no longer silently disables the entire marketplace policy. Plugin reload previews no longer keep unpacked archive files until exit, nor do they overwrite the fallback download cache. ⟦This is like library collection maintenance: books currently borrowed by patrons remain untouched if there is no revised edition, and a few erroneous entries on a procurement list do not shut down the entire library's acquisition policy.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude plugin install` sometimes failing and breaking the installed copy when reinstalling a plugin version that a session or another program was using; an unchanged copy is now left alone
Fixed one malformed `strictKnownMarketplaces` or `blockedMarketplaces` entry silently disabling the whole enterprise marketplace policy
Fixed plugins from the official marketplace being recorded without their commit in `installed_plugins.json`, and `installed_plugins.json` keeping the old commit after updating a pinned-commit plugin
Fixed plugin reload previews keeping every previewed copy of a plugin archive unpacked until exit, and overwriting the cached `--plugin-url` archive a reload falls back to when its download fails
Improved `claude plugin install` on an already-installed plugin: it now says when the marketplace offers a newer version and names the `claude plugin update` command

title.zh-TW: 外掛面板顯示淨化，特殊名稱不再造成技能管理閃退
title.en: Cleaned Plugin Panel Display, Preventing Skill Management Crashes from Reserved Object Property Names

body.zh-TW: 開啟外掛分頁瀏覽已安裝清單時，更新失敗等錯誤訊息現在會自動清除終端機控制字元，確保文字清晰可讀。當技能或舊指令命名為 `constructor` 或 `toString` 等特殊屬性名稱時，`/plugin` 與 `/skills` 介面不再發生閃退。多選安裝全數失敗時會明確顯示失敗通知，不再無聲關閉面板。移除已解除安裝的外掛後，介面不會再殘留「載入失敗」的無效列。獨立列出的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器現在會清楚標示所屬的外掛名稱。⟦這好比應用程式市集的管理面板，即便擴充模組使用了保留字命名，清單依然整齊陳列並清楚標註每個外掛的母套件歸屬。⟧
body.en: When browsing installed plugins on the Installed tab, error messages such as failed plugin updates now strip terminal control characters, ensuring clean, readable text. The `/plugin` and `/skills` interfaces no longer crash when a skill or legacy command is named after built-in Object properties like `constructor` or `toString`. When every install in a multi-select operation fails, the panel now shows an explicit failure notice instead of closing silently. Removing uninstalled plugins no longer leaves orphaned "failed to load" rows in the interface. MCP servers listed separately from their plugins now clearly indicate which plugin they belong to. ⟦This is like an app store management dashboard: even if an extension is named using a reserved word, the list remains neatly arranged and clearly marks which parent package each plugin belongs to.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/plugin` not stripping terminal control characters from messages on the Installed tab, such as the error of a failed plugin update
Fixed `/plugin` → Installed and `/skills` crashing when a skill or legacy command is named like a built-in Object property such as `constructor` or `toString`
Fixed `/plugin` closing with no message when every install in a multi-select failed
Fixed uninstalled plugins reappearing as "failed to load" rows in `/plugin` Installed, and Remove not clearing such a row
Improved `/plugin` Installed: an MCP server listed apart from its plugin now shows which plugin it belongs to

title.zh-TW: 檔案與搜尋工具全面除錯，精確回報系統資源與比對錯誤
title.en: Comprehensive Fixes for File and Search Tools, Accurately Reporting System Resource and Match Errors

body.zh-TW: 當系統耗盡行程、記憶體或檔案控制代碼導致搜尋無法啟動時，`Grep` 與 `Glob` 工具現在會明確報錯，不再誤報為找不到項目。使用 `Write` 工具寫入既有資料夾路徑時，會明確回報錯誤，不再誤判為權限被拒絕。`Edit` 工具在處理包含反斜線或非 ASCII 字元的超大文字時，比對失敗會正確顯示找不到字串，不再拋出正規表達式（用符號比對文字的語法）過大的錯誤。`Edit` 工具也修復了將反斜線後接 `uXXXX` 文字誤當作 `\uXXXX` 跳脫處理的問題，可能導致非 ASCII 字元的編輯意外覆蓋跳脫反斜線序列。路徑中的轉義序列會作為文字處理。Windows 環境下工作目錄長度約 120 個字元以上時讀取 PDF 頁面失敗的問題也已修復。⟦這好比倉庫檢索系統在電力中斷時直接顯示設備異常，而不是回報庫存為零，抄寫特殊編號時也不會誤判代碼。⟧
body.en: When searches cannot start because the system is out of processes, memory, or file handles, the `Grep` and `Glob` tools now return explicit errors instead of incorrectly reporting no matches. Writing to an existing directory path with the `Write` tool now reports a clear error instead of treating it as declined permission. When matching fails on very large edits containing non-ASCII text or backslashes, the `Edit` tool now properly reports that the string was not found instead of throwing a regular expression too large error. The `Edit` tool also fixed an issue where an escaped backslash followed by `uXXXX` text was mistakenly treated as a `\uXXXX` escape sequence, which could cause edits of non-ASCII characters to accidentally overwrite escaped backslashes. Escaped control characters in paths are now handled as literal text. Reading PDF pages on Windows when working folder paths are long (about 120 characters or more) has also been resolved. ⟦This is like a warehouse retrieval system showing an equipment malfunction during a power outage rather than reporting zero stock, and avoiding misinterpreting codes when transcribing special serial numbers.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search could not start because the system was out of processes, memory or file handles; they now return an error saying so
Fixed the Write tool silently ending the turn as a declined permission when the target path is an existing directory; it now reports a clear error
Fixed the Edit tool treating an escaped backslash followed by `uXXXX` text as a `\uXXXX` escape, which could make an edit of a non-ASCII character rewrite an escaped backslash sequence instead
Fixed the Edit tool reporting "Invalid regular expression: regular expression too large" instead of "String not found in file" when a very large edit containing non-ASCII text did not match the file
Fixed a turn ending early with "Path contains null bytes" when a tool call's file path contained `\u0000` written as an escape sequence; escaped control characters now stay as literal text
Fixed PDF page reads on Windows failing when the working folder's path is long (about 120 characters or more)

title.zh-TW: 成果工件發布支援限流重試，專屬工具精確讀取連結
title.en: Rate-Limited Artifact Publishes Support Retries, Dedicated Tool Accurately Reads Artifact Links

body.zh-TW: 以前 Claude 發布內容撞上頻率限制，會被告知別再重試，但其實東西還沒發出去。發布成果工件（Artifact，AI 產生的獨立檔案或程式碼成果）若觸發頻率限制，系統會清楚告知 Claude 本次尚未發布成功並提示重試時間，不再要求它直接放棄。當對話中包含 `claude.ai` 工件連結且 Artifact 工具可用時，Claude 會優先使用專屬的工件工具讀取內容，而非使用泛用的 `WebFetch` 網頁擷取工具。工件工具的權限確認提示語句現在更為簡短，清楚列出頁面與工件的標題或檔名，並將相關連結統一整理在說明文字後方。⟦這宛如快遞櫃在收件櫃位滿載時，清楚告知外送員包裹暫未入櫃並提示下一梯次投遞時間，派件單上也精簡列出包裹名稱與取件條碼。⟧
body.en: Previously, when Claude hit a rate limit while publishing, it was told to stop retrying even though nothing had been published. If publishing an artifact hits rate limits, Claude is now clearly informed that nothing was published along with guidance on when to retry, rather than being told to give up completely. When conversations include `claude.ai` artifact links and the Artifact tool is available, Claude prioritizes reading content with the dedicated Artifact tool instead of using the generic `WebFetch` tool. Permission prompts for the Artifact tool are now more concise, listing pages and artifacts by title or file name while grouping relevant links after the explanatory text. ⟦This is like a parcel locker when full: it clearly informs the courier that the package has not yet been deposited and suggests the next delivery window, while the delivery slip concisely lists package names and pickup barcodes.⟧

items.original:
Fixed rate-limited artifact publishes telling Claude to stop retrying; Claude is now told nothing was published and when to send the same publish again
Improved artifact link handling so Claude reads claude.ai artifact links with the Artifact tool instead of WebFetch when that tool is available
Improved the Artifact tool's permission prompts: shorter sentences, pages and artifacts named by title or file name, and links listed after the text

title.zh-TW: Bash 沙盒複合指令全面受檢，刪除操作主動提示安全防護
title.en: Compound Bash Commands Fully Evaluated Under Sandbox, Dangerous Deletions Prompt Safety Guards

body.zh-TW: 開著沙盒（把指令關在隔離區裡跑的防護）時，有些指令其實不該整條溜出去。啟用沙盒時，在沙盒外執行的 Bash 指令中 `$TMPDIR` 變數不再被展開為空字串。在 `sandbox.excludedCommands` 豁免設定中，複合指令必須所有子指令都符合規則才能豁免於沙盒，防止部分符合就整條跳出防護。當指令涉及高風險的 `rm` 刪除操作時，確認提示會具體點出違規指令並建議加上 `${VAR:?}` 安全防護變數，讓無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的背景運作模式）也能順利復原。雲端環境上的沙盒提示詞採用官方標準用語，明確規範任務權限邊界。⟦這好比工廠重型機具的操作防護門，只有在整串安全感應器全數通過時才允許開啟，啟動危險開關時也必須按下雙手安全確認鍵。⟧
body.en: With the sandbox on (the guard that runs commands in an isolated area), some commands were slipping out of it entirely when they should not have. When sandboxing is enabled, `$TMPDIR` no longer expands to an empty string in Bash commands executed outside the sandbox. Under the `sandbox.excludedCommands` exemption setting, every part of a compound command must match the rule to be exempt from the sandbox, preventing a partial match from bypassing sandboxing entirely. When a command involves high-risk `rm` deletions, the permission prompt explicitly names the flagged command and suggests adding a `${VAR:?}` guard so headless runs can recover. Sandbox prompt instructions on cloud platforms now adopt first-party wording that clearly defines task permission boundaries. ⟦This is like a heavy machinery safety gate in a factory: it opens only when the entire sequence of safety sensors is cleared, and triggering high-risk switches requires pressing dual two-hand safety confirmation buttons.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `$TMPDIR` expanding empty in Bash commands that run outside the sandbox while sandboxing is enabled
Fixed a `sandbox.excludedCommands` glob exempting an entire compound Bash command from the sandbox when only one part matched; every part must now match
Improved the dangerous-rm permission prompt to name the flagged rm command and suggest a `${VAR:?}` guard, so headless runs can recover
Changed the Bash sandbox instructions on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to the first-party wording, which frames the sandbox as the boundary of what the task was given

title.zh-TW: 工作階段接續完整保留快取，附件與平行副本技能正常載入
title.en: Full Cache Preservation on Resumed Sessions, Reliably Loading Attachments and Worktree Skills

body.zh-TW: 用 `--resume` 接回舊對話，以前可能當機，或之後每次請求都失敗。接續執行先前的工作階段時，對話歷史若包含純文字助理訊息或空白文字區塊，不再導致請求失敗或崩潰。在 `/clear`、`--continue` 或 `--resume` 接續對話時，若啟動掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）印出輸出，系統不再遺失首條訊息片段。這項修正避免了快取（暫存提示詞的機制）完全失效。對話附件在重啟後不會被重新渲染，完整保留了思考過程與快取狀態。使用 `--worktree` 開啟平行副本工作階段時，即使 `.claude/skills` 未被版控追蹤，也能順利載入主專案技能。歷史紀錄中包含不完整掛鉤摘要的崩潰問題也已修復。⟦這好比老牌留聲機在接續播放唱片時，即使音軌間穿插靜音段落或插入解說書籤，磁頭依然精準循軌而不破壞母帶音質。⟧
body.en: Picking an old conversation back up with `--resume` could previously crash it, or make every request after it fail. Resuming an earlier session whose history contains plain-string assistant messages or empty text blocks alongside other content no longer causes request failures or crashes. When continuing sessions after `/clear`, `--continue`, or `--resume`, startup hook output no longer causes the first message fragment to be missed, preventing full prompt cache misses. Conversation attachments are no longer re-rendered after a resume or relaunch, fully preserving extended thinking and prompt cache status. Opening worktree sessions with `--worktree` now reliably loads main project skills even when `.claude/skills` is untracked by version control. A crash when resuming transcripts containing incomplete hook summaries has also been resolved. ⟦This is like a vintage gramophone resuming record playback: even if silent gaps or commentary bookmarks are inserted between audio tracks, the needle tracks accurately without degrading the master tape's audio quality.⟧

items.original:
Fixed conversations failing every request with "text content blocks must be non-empty" when an earlier assistant turn held an empty text block beside other content, including after `--resume`
Fixed a crash when resuming a session whose saved history holds an assistant message stored as a plain string
Fixed sessions continued after `/clear` (restart, `--continue`, `--resume`) missing part of their first message when a SessionStart hook printed output, causing a full prompt-cache miss
Fixed a crash ("unrecoverable interface error") when resuming a session whose saved transcript contains a stop hook summary without a well-formed hook list
Fixed project skills from the main repository not loading in `--worktree` sessions when `.claude/skills` is untracked
Fixed attachments recorded earlier in a conversation being re-rendered after a resume or relaunch, which dropped extended thinking and missed the prompt cache

title.zh-TW: 設定檔格式異常安全容錯，啟動與外掛管理不再卡死
title.en: Fault Tolerance for Malformed Configuration Files, Preventing Launch and Plugin Management Freezes

body.zh-TW: `~/.claude.json` 裡只要有一個值格式不對，以前就可能讓 Claude Code 一開就卡住或當掉。使用者在啟動時即便 `customApiKeyResponses` 或 `theme` 主題設定值損毀，互動介面也不會卡死或拋出錯誤。開啟 `/mcp` 工具管理或 `/plugin manage` 外掛面板時，若 `claudeAiMcpEverConnected` 欄位格式異常，不會再引發型別錯誤崩潰。遠端控制工作階段的紀錄簿在遇到格式不正確的佔位紀錄時也能正常運作。⟦這好比智慧音響在讀取記憶卡時，即便遇到幾行毀損的播放清單偏好，依然能平穩開機進入主選單，不影響各項功能操作。⟧
body.en: A single malformed value in `~/.claude.json` used to be enough to make Claude Code hang or crash on launch. Interactive startup no longer hangs or throws errors for users when `customApiKeyResponses` or `theme` values are corrupted. Opening `/mcp` or the `/plugin manage` panel with a malformed `claudeAiMcpEverConnected` field no longer triggers type error crashes. Remote Control session bookkeeping now functions properly even when encountering malformed placeholder records. ⟦This is like a smart speaker reading a memory card: even if it encounters a few corrupted playlist preferences, it still boots smoothly into the main menu without disrupting everyday operations.⟧

items.original:
Fixed interactive start-up hanging or showing an error for `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` users when `~/.claude.json` holds a malformed `customApiKeyResponses` value
Fixed a crash ("Type error") when opening `/mcp` or `/plugin manage` with a malformed `claudeAiMcpEverConnected` value in `~/.claude.json`
Fixed a crash at launch when `~/.claude.json` holds a malformed `theme` value
Fixed Remote Control session bookkeeping failing when `~/.claude.json` holds a malformed placeholder record

title.zh-TW: 多版本並行登入不衝突，更新檢查容錯並自動清理快取
title.en: Conflict-Free Multi-Version Logins, Tolerant Update Checks and Automatic Staging Cache Cleanup

body.zh-TW: 莫名被登出、更新時卡住或誤報，這組修的都是登入與更新時會撞到的問題。當本機同時執行新舊版本時，不再發生帳號無預警被登出的問題。代理伺服器回傳無效版本號時，更新檢查不再每 30 分鐘報錯；有設定最低或最高版本時，`claude update` 不再卡住；格式錯誤的 `minimumVersion` 現在會被忽略。透過 winget 或 apk 安裝時，若查詢版本失敗不再誤報為最新版本。自動更新失敗後會主動清理 `~/.cache/claude/staging`，不再殘留龐大的快取（暫存檔案的空間）。撤銷登入時會提示執行 `/login`，在主控台登入若伺服器拒絕建立 API 金鑰，也會顯示伺服器錯誤訊息。⟦這就像商務大樓的門禁系統，新舊識別證在不同刷卡機讀取不會互相註銷，更新失敗時也會自動清空暫存箱的廢棄包裹。⟧
body.en: Unexpected logouts, stalled or misleading updates: this group fixes problems you can hit while signing in and updating. Running older and newer versions locally no longer causes unexpected account logouts. If a proxy returns an invalid version number, update checks no longer error every 30 minutes; when a minimum or maximum version is set, `claude update` no longer hangs; a malformed `minimumVersion` is now ignored. Installations managed via winget or apk no longer falsely report being up to date when version lookups fail. Failed auto-updates now proactively clean up `~/.cache/claude/staging`, leaving no large staged downloads behind. Errors following revoked logins now lead with `/login`, and Console sign-in displays the server's error message when API key creation is refused. ⟦This is like a commercial building access control system: swiping old and new badges across different readers does not invalidate either, and update failures automatically empty temporary lockers of discarded packages.⟧

items.original:
Fixed being unexpectedly logged out when an older Claude Code build (for example an IDE extension's bundled CLI) runs on the same machine as the current one
Fixed update checks erroring every 30 minutes, and `claude update` hanging when a minimum or maximum version is set, if a proxy returns an invalid version; a malformed `minimumVersion` is now ignored
Fixed `claude update` on winget- or apk-managed installs reporting "up to date" when the version lookup failed
Fixed failed auto-updates leaving large staged downloads behind in `~/.cache/claude/staging`
Fixed the error after a revoked claude.ai login blaming an expired Anthropic profile; it now leads with `/login`
Fixed Console sign-in showing only "Request failed with status code 400" when the server refuses to create an API key; it now shows the server's message

title.zh-TW: 提示詞字元自動過濾清洗，運算中輸入訊息不遺漏
title.en: Automatic Sanitization for Invisible Prompt Characters, Ensuring Inputs During Processing Are Not Dropped

body.zh-TW: Claude 還在忙時你就先打好下一句，這個習慣現在不會再吃虧。當你在 Claude 仍在運算處理時預先鍵入訊息，這些訊息現在會被妥善排程處理，不再被模型遺漏忽視。輸入提示詞時，系統會主動過濾並清除不可見的 Unicode 格式與標籤字元，並在送出前展示清理後的文字供你確認。從歷史紀錄調出或自外部編輯器載入包含終端機顏色代碼的提示詞時，不再觸發無法復原的介面錯誤崩潰。⟦這如同郵局的自動分信機，在信件送入分揀槽前先撫平紙張並濾除隱形水印雜質，在處理前一封郵件時也不會漏掉排隊中的新包裹。⟧
body.en: If you like to type your next message while Claude is still busy, that habit no longer costs you. Messages typed while Claude is actively working are now properly processed rather than being ignored by the model. When prompts are entered, invisible Unicode formatting and tag characters are automatically stripped, displaying the cleaned prompt for your review before sending. Loading prompts containing terminal color codes from history or an external editor no longer triggers unrecoverable interface crashes. ⟦This is like an automated mail sorting machine at the post office: it flattens envelopes and filters out invisible watermark impurities before letters enter sorting bins, without dropping incoming queued packages while processing previous mail.⟧
