items.original:
Fixed a crash ("unrecoverable interface error") when the prompt held text containing terminal color codes, for example a prompt recalled from history or text loaded from the external editor
Fixed messages typed while Claude is still working sometimes being ignored by the model
Improved prompt handling: invisible Unicode formatting and tag characters in a prompt are removed and the cleaned prompt is shown for review before it is sent

title.zh-TW: 終端機渲染效能穩定提升，全螢幕文字選取複製即時回饋
title.en: Stable Terminal Rendering Enhancements, Real-Time Feedback on Fullscreen Text Copying

body.zh-TW: 慢電腦上剛啟動就當掉、少數情況下畫面停住不動，這兩件事不會再發生。在電腦高負載時啟動工作階段，介面不再因為首次顯示旋轉載入圖示而崩潰退出。內部渲染錯誤後螢幕可能停止刷新的問題已排除，確保畫面在整個工作階段期間持續即時更新。在全螢幕的 `/resume` 工作階段選擇器與其他覆蓋輸入區的面板中，透過滑鼠拖曳選取文字後，已能正常顯示已複製的提示通知。啟動時商標下方的過長通知提示行，改為以隱藏 N 則通知的簡明文字呈現。⟦這宛如機場大廳的高解析航班看板，即使人潮擁擠時開啟電源也不會黑屏當機，滑鼠選取航班代碼時也會即時彈出複製完成的提示。⟧
body.en: Crashing right after launch on slow machines and, in rare cases, a screen that stops updating: neither happens anymore. Launching sessions under heavy system load no longer crashes with unrecoverable interface errors when the initial spinner appears. A rare issue where the screen could stop updating for the rest of the session after an internal rendering error has been eliminated, ensuring continuous live updates. In the fullscreen `/resume` session picker and other panels covering the prompt area, drag-selecting text with the mouse now reliably displays the copied notice. Startup overflow lines under the logo now concisely show how many notices are hidden. ⟦This is like a high-resolution airport departure board: turning on power during crowded peak hours does not result in a black screen crash, and selecting flight codes with a mouse instantly triggers a copied notification.⟧

items.original:
Fixed sessions on slow or heavily loaded machines sometimes exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error" when the first spinner appeared
Fixed a rare case where the screen could stop updating for the rest of the session after an internal rendering error
Fixed the "copied" notice not appearing after drag-selecting text in the fullscreen `/resume` picker and other panels that cover the prompt area
Improved the startup notice overflow line under the logo: it now reads "N more notices hidden" instead of "+N more · /status"

title.zh-TW: 審查指令指引更智慧，模型清單常駐並精確回報拒絕原因
title.en: Smarter Code Review Command Guidance, Persistent Model Listings with Clear Refusal Explanations

body.zh-TW: 執行程式碼審查指令 `/ultrareview` 時，若無待審變更，介面會說明情境並提供審查最新提交紀錄的指令，對新套件庫的首個提交也會完整審查；非互動環境中若無基礎分支或共同歷史則會明確拒絕。在 Anthropic API 模式下，`/model` 清單一律會顯示 Fable 模型，僅在組織停用時反灰。在 Cowork 雲端工作階段中，`WebFetch` 網頁擷取與 `WebSearch` 搜尋工具在請求被拒時會明確告知 Claude 具體原因，例如額度用盡或管理員策略限制。Windows 上回覆後因記憶體不足導致工具呼叫未執行的問題也已修復。⟦這好比報社的審稿總監，桌面沒有新投稿時會主動提議複審最新專欄，調閱權限不足時也會標明原因。⟧
body.en: When running the code review command `/ultrareview` with nothing to review, the interface now explains the context and offers a command to review your latest commit, while the first commit in a new repository is reviewed in full; in non-interactive sessions, it explicitly refuses when the repository lacks a base branch or shared history. On the Anthropic API, Fable now always appears in the `/model` list, appearing greyed out only when disabled by organization settings. In Cowork cloud sessions, `WebFetch` and `WebSearch` now clearly inform Claude of the exact reason when requests are refused, such as a used-up fetch budget or admin policy restrictions. An issue on Windows where out-of-memory errors immediately following Claude's reply prevented tool calls from executing has also been resolved. ⟦This is like an editor-in-chief at a newspaper: when there are no new submissions on the desk, they proactively suggest reviewing the latest column, and clearly state reasons when access permissions are insufficient.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a rare case on Windows where a turn could stop with an error such as "Out of memory" right after Claude replied, so that reply's tool calls never ran
Fixed WebFetch and WebSearch in Cowork cloud sessions not telling Claude why a request was refused, such as a used-up fetch budget or an admin policy
Improved `/ultrareview` when there's nothing to review: messages say which case you're in, offer a command that reviews your latest commit, and a new repository's first commit is reviewed in full
Changed Fable to always appear in `/model` on the Anthropic API; it is greyed out only when your organization's settings disable it
Changed `/ultrareview` in non-interactive sessions to refuse when the repository has no base branch or shared history

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 面板選單支援快速登出，背景任務與用量統計全面納管
title.en: [VSCode] Panel Menu Supports Quick Logout, Comprehensively Managing Background Tasks and Usage Metrics

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡用 Claude Code 的人，這版多了登出、停止背景任務、複製回應等幾項新操作。面板選單中新增了「Sign out」登出選項，並支援在指令列鍵入 `/logout` 快速登出。代理地圖中現在納入了背景終端機與執行中的背景任務，每項任務均配備停止按鈕，並可透過 `/tasks` 指令直接開啟檢視。AI 回覆訊息旁新增了複製按鈕，亦可鍵入 `/copy` 複製完整回覆。閒置的工作階段被自動封存時會彈出單次提示，封存分組中也新增了全部解除封存按鈕。在不適用方案上限的環境中，帳戶用量對話框與工作階段管理器現在會顯示花費與 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）使用量。⟦這就像辦公室的高級智慧中控台，將正在背景運作的印表機與碎紙機一併列出管理按鈕，並在公文夾自動歸檔時發出貼心通知。⟧
body.en: If you use Claude Code in VS Code, this release adds new actions such as signing out, stopping background tasks, and copying responses. A "Sign out" row has been added to the panel menu, along with support for typing `/logout` in the command menu. The agent map now includes background shells and running tasks, each equipped with a Stop button, and can be opened directly with `/tasks`. A Copy response button is now available beside AI responses, alongside a typed `/copy` command. A one-time notice appears when inactive sessions are archived automatically, and an "Unarchive all" action has been added to the Archived sessions group. In environments where plan limits do not apply, the Account & usage dialog and session manager now display costs and token usage. ⟦This is like an office's advanced smart control console: it lists management controls for background printers and shredders alike, while sending a helpful notification whenever document folders are automatically archived.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a Sign out row to the panel menu, with `/logout` in the typed command menu
[VSCode] Added background shells and other running tasks to the agent map, each with a Stop, and a typed `/tasks` that opens it
[VSCode] Added a Copy response button on responses and a typed `/copy`
[VSCode] Added a one-time notice when inactive sessions are archived automatically, and an "Unarchive all" action on the Archived sessions group
[VSCode] Added the session's cost and token usage to the Account & usage dialog and the session manager where plan limits do not apply (Vertex, Bedrock, Foundry, API key)

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 設定與功能選單直覺開啟，思考程度與快速模式持久保存
title.en: [VSCode] Intuitive Settings and Feature Menus, Persisting Effort Levels and Fast Mode

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡設好的偏好，以前重開後可能就不見了。點選「General config」選單項目現在會直接開啟設定頁面，鍵入 `/mcp`、`/hooks`（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）、`/memory`、`/rewind` 等指令也能直接叫出對應的設定對話框。透過思考程度滑桿設定的數值，現在會跨工作階段持續保存，不再遺失先前以 `/effort` 儲存的等級。以不同大小寫別名（例如「Sonnet」）儲存模型時，模式選擇器不再遺漏自動模式選項。執行 `/fast` 指令切換的快速模式已能正確儲存為預設值，重新啟動後依然生效。⟦這宛如專業相機的自訂轉盤，將快捷選單與光圈設定精準儲存在機身記憶體中，重新開機後依然維持你最熟悉的拍攝模式。⟧
body.en: Preferences you set in VS Code could previously vanish after a restart. Clicking the "General config" menu item now opens settings directly, and typing commands such as `/mcp`, `/hooks`, `/memory`, and `/rewind` directly opens their respective dialogs. Effort levels adjusted via the slider now persist across sessions on models that already had a level saved with `/effort`. The mode picker no longer misses the Auto option when saved model settings use differently-cased aliases like "Sonnet". Toggling fast mode with `/fast` is now correctly saved as the default, remaining active after restarts. ⟦This is like a custom dial on a professional camera: it securely stores shortcut menus and aperture settings in internal memory, preserving your familiar shooting mode even after powering back on.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the "General config" menu row showing `/config` usage text instead of opening settings, and made typed `/mcp`, `/hooks`, `/memory`, `/rewind` and similar commands open their dialogs
[VSCode] Fixed the effort slider's level not persisting into later sessions on a model that already had a level saved with `/effort`
[VSCode] Fixed Auto missing from the mode picker for conversations opened in an already-used panel when the saved model setting is a differently-cased alias such as "Sonnet"
[VSCode] Fixed `/fast` not saving fast mode as the default, so it was lost when the extension relaunched Claude Code

title.zh-TW: [網頁版] 雲端環境分層管理，支援組織共用與嚴謹網路限制
title.en: [Claude Code on the Web] Tiered Cloud Environment Management, Supporting Organization Sharing and Network Safeguards

body.zh-TW: 在 Team 或 Enterprise 方案裡共用雲端環境，最怕分不清哪個是自己的、哪個大家都在用。在 Team 與 Enterprise 企業方案中，雲端環境選擇器現在劃分為個人與組織兩個專屬區塊，管理員可直接將個人建立的環境共享給整個組織。組織共用環境在 Code 分頁中預設以唯讀摘要呈現，防止非管理員誤觸修改，編輯功能統一移至管理員設定的雲端環境專區。設定為自訂網路存取但未填寫任何網域的雲端環境，不再無聲還原為受信任模式，儲存時會主動要求至少填入一個網域。管理員設定中的標籤已重新命名為「Cloud sessions」（雲端工作階段），並移除了下方多餘的唯讀行動裝置列。⟦這就像共用辦公空間的會議室門禁權限，個人專用室可升級為全員會議室，並將調整格局的權限嚴格保留給大樓管委會。⟧
body.en: When a Team or Enterprise plan shares cloud environments, the hard part is telling which ones are yours and which ones everyone uses. On Team and Enterprise plans, the cloud environment picker is now divided into Personal and Organization sections, allowing admins to share personal environments with the entire organization. Organization environments open as read-only summaries by default on the Code tab to prevent unauthorized modifications, while editing is consolidated under Admin settings → Cloud environments. Cloud environments saved with Custom network access and no domains no longer silently revert to Trusted mode, and the dialog now requires at least one domain. The admin setting label has been renamed to "Cloud sessions", removing the redundant read-only Mobile row beneath it. ⟦This is like conference room access control in a shared office space: private rooms can be upgraded to all-hands meeting rooms, while the authority to alter room layouts remains strictly reserved for building management.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Added Personal and Organization sections to the environment picker on Team and Enterprise plans, and admins can now share a personal environment with the organization
[Claude Code on the web] Changed organization environments to open as a read-only summary from the Code tab on Team and Enterprise plans, with editing under Admin settings → Cloud environments
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed a cloud environment saved with Custom network access and no domains silently reverting to Trusted; the dialog now asks for at least one domain
[Claude Code on the web] Changed the admin Claude Code setting labeled "Web" to "Cloud sessions" and removed the redundant read-only Mobile row beneath it

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 排程跨頻道讀取修復，憑證設定表單與連線日誌升級
title.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Cross-Channel Routine Reads, Upgraded Credential Forms and Network Logs

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 裡用 Claude Tag 的團隊，這組修正集中在排程和存取憑證兩塊。在 Slack Enterprise Grid 全組織安裝環境的頻道中建立的例行排程，執行時已能正常讀取同工作區內的其他公開頻道。存取套件中的憑證（用於登入與授權的證明檔案）預設項目上的連結，現在會直接導向各服務供應商專屬的憑證設定指南，而非通用的 API 文件。Pylon 憑證預設項目支援管理員手動指向其歐洲伺服器主機。Google Cloud 憑證表單在上傳金鑰被拒時會具體說明原因，網站與 scopes 會維持鎖定，並在替換被拒時保留貼上的金鑰。管理員設定中的網路事件日誌已修復使用 AWS 簽章、用戶端憑證或自訂憑證授權單位連線時遺漏回應狀態的問題。⟦這好比國際商務中心的數位通行證申辦處，申請表單精確導向各國使館的專屬簽證網頁，遇到資料格式不符時也會保留已填寫的欄位方便重新送審。⟧
body.en: For teams using Claude Tag in Slack, this group of fixes centers on routines and access credentials. Routines created in a Slack channel on an Enterprise Grid org-wide install can now properly read other public channels in their workspace when running. Links on credential presets in Claude Tag access bundles now open each vendor's dedicated credential-setup page instead of generic API documentation. Admins can now point the Pylon credential preset at Pylon's EU host. Google Cloud credential forms in access bundles now explain why a key file is refused, the website and scopes stay locked, and pasted keys are preserved when a replacement is rejected. The network events log in admin settings fixed missing response statuses for connections using AWS signing, client certificates, or a custom CA. ⟦This is like a digital pass application desk at an international business center: application forms direct you precisely to dedicated embassy visa pages, and retain filled-in fields when submissions fail so they can be easily corrected and re-submitted.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed routines created in a Slack channel on an Enterprise Grid org-wide install failing to read other public channels in their workspace when they ran
[Claude Tag] Fixed the "Learn more" links on credential presets in Claude Tag access bundles to open each vendor's credential-setup page instead of a generic API reference
[Claude Tag] Changed the Pylon credential preset in Claude Tag access bundles so admins can point it at Pylon's EU host
[Claude Tag] Fixed Google Cloud credential forms in Claude Tag access bundles: a refused key file now says why, the website and scopes stay locked, and a rejected rotation keeps the pasted key
[Claude Tag] Fixed the network events log in Claude Tag admin settings showing no response status for requests through connections that use AWS signing, client certificates or a custom CA

title.zh-TW: 開啟本機 TUI 畫面時預設關閉推理摘要
title.en: Local TUI sessions now disable reasoning summaries by default

body.zh-TW: 你在終端機開啟本機 TUI（在終端機操作的文字互動介面）工作階段時，現在預設不會主動開啟推理摘要。以前如果串接不支援推理摘要的模型供應商，送出對話時請求常會被對方直接拒絕並跳出錯誤，現在預設關閉後就能正常連線。⟦寄包裹時預設只填標準運送單，不再自動夾帶特殊電子格式，以前不支援該格式的代收店家會直接拒收包裹，現在所有站所都能正常收件；要是你特別設定要附，才會一併送出。⟧如果你先前已經在設定檔中指定過推理摘要選項，原本的設定依然會保留並繼續生效。
body.en: When you start a local TUI (text user interface) session in your terminal, reasoning summaries are now turned off by default. Previously, connecting to a model provider that did not support reasoning summaries would cause requests to be rejected with an error; leaving them off by default avoids these connection failures. ⟦Think of sending a parcel with a standard shipping form instead of automatically attaching a specialized electronic slip: older partner shops that did not support the format used to reject packages on the spot, but now every station accepts deliveries normally unless you explicitly choose to include the extra slip.⟧ If you already configured explicit reasoning summary options in your settings, your preferences remain saved and will continue to work.

items.original: New local TUI sessions now leave reasoning summaries disabled by default, fixing request rejection by providers that do not support them. Explicit reasoning-summary settings remain respected. (#46467)

title.zh-TW: 語音對話實驗功能上線，支援即時逐字稿與麥克風控制
title.en: Experimental Voice Conversations Now Live with Real-Time Transcripts and Microphone Controls

body.zh-TW: 想直接用語音向 AI 說明需求而不想一直敲鍵盤？Codex 在支援的建置版本中推出了實驗性的 `/voice` 語音對話功能。⟦這就像隨身對講機加裝了即時字幕螢幕與收音切換鍵，開口說話的同時螢幕立刻浮現逐字稿，既能動口暢談也能隨時調整收音狀態。⟧你只需先在對話中輸入 `/experimental` 指令開啟實驗性功能清單，就能啟用這項模式。進入語音對話後，終端機畫面會同步顯示即時對話轉錄（transcript，將語音同步轉成文字的逐字紀錄），同時提供專門的麥克風控制項供你切換收音狀態，讓口語溝通與文字紀錄同步並行。
body.en: Want to explain your requirements to the AI directly with your voice instead of constantly typing on a keyboard? Codex has introduced experimental `/voice` conversations on supported builds. ⟦This is like equipping a walkie-talkie with a live subtitle screen and an audio input switch, where speaking immediately displays transcripts on-screen while allowing you to adjust recording states at any time.⟧ You only need to type the `/experimental` command in a conversation to open the experimental features list and enable this mode. After entering a voice conversation, the terminal screen simultaneously displays live transcripts alongside dedicated microphone controls to toggle audio capture states, keeping spoken communication and written records in sync.

items.original: Added experimental `/voice` conversations with live transcripts and microphone controls on supported builds, enabled through `/experimental`. (#43581, #43651, #44331)

title.zh-TW: 狀態列即時顯示推論摘要，回合完成附帶時間戳記
title.en: Status Row Displays Live Reasoning Summaries with Completion Timestamps

body.zh-TW: 等待 AI 思考程式碼架構時，你不再需要對著空白畫面發呆。現在文字終端機介面的狀態列（status row，終端機底部的即時狀態提示區）會同步顯示即時推論摘要，清楚交代模型當前的思考步驟。當該回合順利完成後，畫面還會主動標註完成時間戳記。⟦這好比搭乘高鐵時車廂前端的跑馬燈，行進間即時顯示列車當前通過的站點與行車動態，抵達後則清楚標示靠站時間。⟧有了這項改進，你隨時都能掌握目前的運算進度與確切完成時刻。
body.en: You no longer need to stare at a blank screen while waiting for the AI to reason about code architecture. The terminal UI status row now displays live reasoning summaries in real time, clearly showing the model's current thinking steps. Once a turn completes successfully, the screen also proactively displays a completion timestamp. ⟦This is like the digital marquee at the front of a high-speed train carriage, showing upcoming stations and train status while in transit, then clearly displaying arrival times upon reaching the destination.⟧ With this improvement, you can stay informed about ongoing computation progress and exact completion times.

items.original: The TUI now shows live reasoning summaries in the status row and completion timestamps after successful turns. (#43558, #43921)

title.zh-TW: 代理人總覽支援任務隱藏封存與刪除，工作樹顯示歸屬並安全清理
title.en: Agents Overview Adds Task Hiding, Archiving, and Deletion with Worktree Ownership and Safe Cleanup

body.zh-TW: 管理多個背景代理人與平行分支時，專案總覽介面變得更井然有序。代理人總覽頁面現在支援任務的隱藏、封存與刪除功能，方便你隨時整理已完成或暫時不需追蹤的項目。此外，系統也加入了工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）的歸屬詳細資訊，並支援在二次確認後安全刪除乾淨無殘留修改的託管工作樹。⟦如同專案看板主管整理工作區，不僅能將已結案的任務便條暫時隱藏、封存或撕除，還能清楚看見每張延伸實驗桌由誰負責，並安全拆除已收拾乾淨的閒置工作台。⟧這讓維護龐大專案時的平行分支變得更加清爽安全。
body.en: Managing multiple background agents and parallel branches is now much more organized. The agents overview page now supports hiding, archiving, and deleting tasks, making it easy to organize completed items or tasks you no longer need to track. In addition, the system includes worktree ownership details and supports confirmed deletion of clean managed worktrees without lingering modifications. ⟦Just like a project manager organizing a Kanban board, you can hide, archive, or remove completed task notes, clearly see who is responsible for each extension workbench, and safely dismantle clean, idle desks.⟧ This keeps parallel branches cleaner and safer when maintaining large projects.

items.original: Added task hiding, archiving, and deletion in the agents overview, plus worktree ownership details and confirmed deletion of clean managed worktrees. (#43942, #44424, #44433)

title.zh-TW: MCP 支援 Mac 指紋驗證，OAuth 憑證過期提供重連指引
title.en: MCP Supports Touch ID on Mac with Reconnect Guidance for Expired OAuth Credentials

body.zh-TW: 在 Mac 上使用命令列介面串接外部工具時，安全驗證變得更俐落省時。針對支援的 Mac 機種，本機文字終端機的工作階段現在支援以 Touch ID 指紋辨識來驗證 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的操作請求。同時，當外部 MCP 伺服器的 OAuth 授權憑證過期時，系統能精確回報錯誤狀態。一旦授權權杖（token，用來驗證身分的授權令牌）重新整理失敗，介面還會主動提供清楚的重新連線指引，引導你完成登入驗證。⟦這好似重要庫房引進了雙重驗證門禁，本機調用工具時只需輕觸指紋即可快速放行；而當外部特約廠商的通行權杖失效時，系統也會清楚告知問題並指示換證窗口，不再無故中斷。⟧
body.en: Security verification is now faster and more streamlined when connecting external tools via the command line on macOS. On supported Mac models, local terminal UI sessions now support Touch ID verification for MCP (Model Context Protocol) operation requests. Meanwhile, when OAuth credentials on external MCP servers expire, the system accurately reports the error state. If token refresh fails, the interface proactively provides clear reconnection guidance to walk you through login verification. ⟦This is like introducing dual-factor access control to a warehouse: local tool invocations are quickly granted with a fingerprint touch, and when an external contractor's pass expires, the system explains the issue and directs them to the renewal desk rather than abruptly cutting access.⟧

items.original:
Added Touch ID verification for MCP requests in local TUI sessions on supported Macs. (#43624, #43712, #43715)
MCP servers now report expired OAuth credentials accurately and provide reconnect guidance when token refresh fails. (#43947, #44359)

title.zh-TW: 守護行程支援自訂更新排程，重啟後自動還原對話與目標
title.en: Daemon Supports Configurable Update Schedules with Thread and Goal Recovery After Restarts

body.zh-TW: 常駐背景執行的伺服器現在具備更靈活的更新彈性與還原韌性。你可以自訂守護行程（daemon，在背景持續運作的常駐服務程式）的自動更新排程，或隨時執行 `codex app-server daemon update` 指令手動檢查並套用更新。更棒的是，即使守護行程在背景重新啟動，已儲存的對話串與當前進行中的目標也能自動恢復，不會因服務重啟而遺失工作脈絡。⟦宛如全天候運作的大樓中央空調，管理員能自訂夜間例行維護時程或隨時手動升級設備，且重啟後能立刻接續原本設定的各區溫控目標與運行紀錄，不中斷整體服務。⟧
body.en: Background servers now offer more flexible updates and recovery resilience. You can configure automatic update schedules for the daemon or run `codex app-server daemon update` at any time to manually check and apply updates. Furthermore, even if the daemon restarts in the background, saved threads and active goals recover automatically without losing workflow context. ⟦Like a 24/7 central HVAC system where building managers can schedule nighttime maintenance or perform manual upgrades, the system immediately restores temperature goals and operational logs across zones upon restarting without interrupting overall service.⟧

items.original: Added configurable daemon update schedules and `codex app-server daemon update`; saved threads and active goals can recover after daemon restarts. (#43542, #43562, #44314)

title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 支援指令取得 AWS 憑證，具備快取與自動重新整理
title.en: Amazon Bedrock Supports Command-Based AWS Credentials with Caching and Auto-Refresh

body.zh-TW: 透過 Amazon Bedrock 調用模型時，雲端憑證的管理變得更加自動化。系統現在可以直接執行你所設定的自訂指令來取得 AWS 登入憑證，並利用快取（caching，把查過的資料暫存起來直接用）機制將憑證暫存備用。當憑證即將過期時，背景會依據有效期限自動重新整理，並在遭遇認證異常時主動執行復原程序。⟦如同飯店櫃檯向總公司驗證貴賓身分時，能依據指定指令自動派發電子房卡，將房卡暫存備用並在時效屆滿前自動換發，遇到刷卡異常還能自動重試修復。⟧這免去了頻繁手動更新金鑰的繁瑣步驟。
body.en: Cloud credential management is now more automated when invoking models via Amazon Bedrock. The system can now execute configured custom commands directly to obtain AWS credentials and cache them for subsequent use. When credentials near expiration, background processes automatically refresh them based on their lifespan and initiate recovery procedures if authentication anomalies occur. ⟦Like a hotel front desk requesting guest verification from headquarters, the system issues electronic keycards via specified commands, caches them for reuse, renews them before expiration, and retries upon swipe errors.⟧ This eliminates the hassle of manually updating keys frequently.

items.original: Amazon Bedrock can now obtain AWS credentials from configured commands, with caching, expiration-based refresh, and authentication recovery. (#44028)

title.zh-TW: 提示詞壓縮失敗仍妥善保留，修復 tmux 縮放與對話歷史顯示問題
title.en: Accepted Prompts Preserved on Compaction Failures with Fixes for tmux Resizes and History Viewports

body.zh-TW: 對話記錄過長或頻繁切換工作視窗時，文字與畫面狀態現在都能穩定留存。即便在對話回合開始前遇到歷程壓縮（compaction，精簡過往對話以節省空間的機制）失敗，系統依然會完整保留你剛輸入並被接受的提示詞，避免心血白費。此外，這次更新也修正了 tmux 終端機視窗縮放事件漏失、對話逐字紀錄視角無法正確還原，以及切換不同對話串後出現過期舊紀錄的顯示問題。⟦這就像秘書手上的速記本與展示看板，即使先前筆記摘要整理失敗，新交代的工作事項依然會穩穩記下；當你調整窗格大小或翻頁切換不同專案時，畫面也能精準對齊當前進度，不再殘留上一頁的舊草稿。⟧
body.en: Text and screen states now remain stable during long conversations or frequent window switching. Even if history compaction fails before a turn begins, the system completely preserves accepted prompts to prevent lost input. Additionally, this update fixes missed tmux resize events, transcript viewport restoration issues, and stale history appearing after switching between threads. ⟦Like a secretary's shorthand notebook and display board, new instructions are reliably recorded even if earlier summary compilations fail; when resizing panes or flipping between projects, the display precisely aligns with current progress without leaving outdated drafts from previous pages.⟧

items.original:
Accepted prompts are now saved even when compaction fails before a turn starts. (#44487)
Fixed missed tmux resizes, transcript viewport restoration, and stale history appearing after switching threads. (#43603, #43889, #43994)

title.zh-TW: 自動核准審查保留完整操作與佐證，支援失敗重試並釐清危險警示
title.en: Automatic Approval Reviews Preserve Full Actions and Evidence with Retry Support and Clarified Risk Alerts

body.zh-TW: 仰賴系統自動審核高權限操作時，判斷流程現在更具可信度與容錯力。自動核准審查機制在評估時能更可靠地保留完整操作步驟與授權佐證，提供完整的稽核依據。面對網路或伺服器引發的暫時性故障，審查流程會自動重試；同時也能明確區分審查流程本身的執行失敗與真正偵測到危險操作的警示結果，避免將系統異常誤判為安全威脅。⟦猶如海關自動通關閘門，不僅會妥善保存整份申報單據與查驗佐證，遇到感應器短暫連線逾時會自動重試，並明確區分是讀卡機線路故障還是旅客違規，不會把設備錯誤誤判成走私。⟧
body.en: Automated review of elevated permissions is now more reliable and fault-tolerant. Automatic approval reviews preserve complete action steps and authorization evidence more reliably during evaluation, providing a solid audit trail. The review process automatically retries upon transient network or server failures, while clearly distinguishing review execution failures from unsafe-action findings to avoid misclassifying system anomalies as security threats. ⟦Like an automated customs e-gate, it preserves full declaration forms and inspection evidence, retries automatically during brief sensor timeouts, and clearly distinguishes card reader network faults from passenger violations instead of mistaking hardware glitches for smuggling.⟧

items.original: Automatic approval reviews now preserve complete actions and authorization evidence more reliably, retry transient failures, and distinguish review failures from unsafe-action findings. (#44482, #44569, #44570)

title.zh-TW: 切換帳號自動失效前身分工作階段，清除連線快取與模型目錄
title.en: Account Switching Invalidates Previous Sessions While Clearing Connection Caches and Model Catalogs

body.zh-TW: 在同一台電腦切換不同使用者帳號時，前一個帳號的敏感連線與資源將被徹底清空。一旦完成身分切換，系統會立即讓屬於前一身分的遠端控制工作階段全部失效，並清除快取（cache，把連線狀態暫存起來的機制）的 WebSocket 連線資料與模型目錄，確保不同帳號間的權限與資料完全隔離。⟦正如不同員工輪班共用同一台工作站，交接登出時系統會立即切斷先前的遠端連線、清空所有暫存連線狀態與前一位員工專屬的權限目錄，徹底防範身分混淆。⟧
body.en: Switching between user accounts on the same machine now completely clears sensitive connections and resources from the previous identity. Once account switching completes, the system immediately invalidates all remote-control sessions belonging to the prior identity and clears cached WebSocket connection state and model catalogs, ensuring complete isolation of permissions and data between accounts. ⟦Just like shift workers sharing a workstation, logging out during handoff immediately severs prior remote sessions, clears cached connection states, and wipes access catalogs belonging to the previous employee to prevent identity crossover.⟧

items.original: Switching accounts now invalidates remote-control sessions, cached WebSocket state, and model catalogs belonging to the previous identity. (#43906, #44341, #44489)

title.zh-TW: 封鎖 WSL 沙盒程式逃逸，強化 Shell 快照防止憑證外洩
title.en: Blocks WSL Sandbox Escapes and Hardens Shell Snapshots Against Credential Leaks

body.zh-TW: 在受限環境中執行腳本或指令時，系統安全防護進一步升級。Codex 成功阻擋了在受限的 WSL 沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護環境）中逃逸並啟動 Windows 程序的漏洞。同時，系統也強化了中介代理 Shell 快照的保護機制，防止機密的登入憑證在環境快照中遭到外洩。⟦彷彿在隔離實驗艙四周築起防護網，既防止內部程式繞道穿透到宿主作業系統，又將中介連線的系統快照嚴密加密，杜絕任何敏感金鑰外洩的漏洞。⟧這讓你在隔離環境測試未知程式碼時更加安心。
body.en: Security safeguards are further enhanced when running scripts or commands in restricted environments. Codex successfully blocks escapes from restricted WSL sandboxes that attempt to launch Windows processes. Meanwhile, the system hardens brokered shell snapshots to prevent confidential credentials from leaking through environment snapshots. ⟦Like building a protective barrier around an isolated lab chamber, it prevents internal programs from bypassing boundaries to the host operating system while locking down brokered shell snapshots to eliminate credential exposure.⟧ This gives you greater peace of mind when testing untrusted code in isolated environments.

items.original: Blocked Windows-process escapes from restricted WSL sandboxes and hardened brokered shell snapshots against credential exposure. (#44286, #43909, #44040)

title.zh-TW: Python SDK 與執行階段同步穩定版 CLI 發布，版本統一並預先驗證資源
title.en: Python SDK and Runtime Align with Stable CLI Releases with Matching Versions and Pre-Validated Assets

body.zh-TW: 使用 Python 開發套件呼叫 Codex 服務時，套件版本與核心工具將保持緊密同步。Python SDK 與執行階段套件的發布流程現在全面對齊穩定版 CLI 發布，雙方採用完全一致的版本號碼。在 SDK 正式上架發布前，系統還會嚴格驗證執行階段所需的各項資源檔案，確保套件環境完備無虞。⟦這恰似品牌推出新產品時，將週邊配件、軟體套件與主機出廠編號同步對齊，並在配件上架前先行檢驗核心組件的完整性，確保使用者開箱即用不撞期。⟧這能有效避免套件版本錯置或缺檔的困擾。
body.en: Package versions and core tools now stay closely synchronized when invoking Codex services via Python. Publishing workflows for the Python SDK and runtime packages are now fully aligned with stable CLI releases, using matching version numbers across both. Before SDK publication, the system rigorously verifies required runtime assets to ensure a complete and ready environment. ⟦Like launching a new product where accessories, software suites, and main hardware share matching release numbers while verifying core components before launch, this ensures an out-of-the-box experience without schedule mismatches.⟧ This effectively prevents mismatched versions or missing asset issues.

items.original: Aligned Python SDK and runtime publishing with stable CLI releases, using matching versions and verifying runtime assets before SDK publication. (#44067)

title.zh-TW: GPT-6-Astra 上架模型挑選器與 Bedrock，官方文件同步補上轉移指引
title.en: GPT-6-Astra Arrives in Model Picker and Bedrock with Updated Migration Guides

body.zh-TW: 開發時想嘗試最新一代模型？現在進入模型挑選器（model picker，供切換不同 AI 版本的選單）即可直接選用 GPT-6-Astra。這項更新也同步推送到 Amazon Bedrock 的服務目錄中。若你正打算將既有專案遷移過來，內建的 OpenAI Docs 技能也已全面更新，針對 GPT-6-Astra 提供專門的轉移步驟、相容性說明與提示詞撰寫指引。⟦這就像車商正式將新旗艦車款陳列在展示中心與特約經銷商的型錄上，同時隨車手冊也立即換上新版的升級指南、相容說明與駕駛操作技巧。⟧無論你透過本機選單還是雲端目錄調用，都能直接對照指引順利切換。
body.en: Looking to try the latest model during development? You can now select GPT-6-Astra directly from the model picker. This update is also available in the Amazon Bedrock service catalog. If you plan to migrate existing projects, the bundled OpenAI Docs skill has been updated with dedicated migration steps, compatibility notes, and prompting guidance for GPT-6-Astra. ⟦It is like a carmaker showcasing a new flagship model in showrooms and dealership catalogs, while immediately updating the owner's manual with upgrade guides, compatibility details, and driving tips.⟧ Whether you invoke it from the local menu or cloud catalog, you can switch smoothly by following the guides.

items.original:
GPT-6-Astra is now available in the model picker and Amazon Bedrock catalogs. (#42879, #42619)
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs skill with GPT-6-Astra migration, compatibility, and prompting guidance. (#42931)

title.zh-TW: 實驗性工作樹支援登場，獨立簽出目錄支援瀏覽與續接
title.en: Experimental Worktree Support Arrives to Browse and Resume Isolated Checkouts

body.zh-TW: 你想同時處理多條開發分支又不想弄亂現有目錄？Codex 新增了實驗性的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）支援。⟦這恰似圖書館為大型研究計畫增設獨立自修室，研究員可以帶著資料副本到專用房間閉門作業，中途可以走出房間瀏覽各室進度，稍後也能重新進房接續未完的研究，完全不會佔用大廳的公共閱覽桌。⟧現在只要在啟動時加上 `--worktree` 旗標，或在對話中輸入 `/worktree` 指令，就能為全新或分支衍生出的工作階段建立彼此隔離的簽出目錄。建立之後，你還能隨心瀏覽所有存在的工作樹，並重新續接先前的工作進度。
body.en: Want to work on multiple branches simultaneously without cluttering your current directory? Codex now introduces experimental worktree support. ⟦This is like a library setting up private study rooms for major research projects, allowing researchers to work behind closed doors with copies of materials, step out to browse progress across rooms, and return later to resume unfinished work without occupying shared reading tables.⟧ Simply pass the `--worktree` flag at startup or enter the `/worktree` command in a conversation to create isolated checkout directories for new or forked sessions. Once created, you can browse all existing worktrees and resume earlier progress at any time.

items.original: Experimental worktree support lets you create isolated checkouts for new or forked sessions using `--worktree` or `/worktree`, then browse and resume them. (#42652, #43069, #43120, #43286)

title.zh-TW: 背景執行中直接行內回答提問，提供建議選項且不丟失草稿
title.en: Answer Questions Inline While Working in Background Without Losing Drafts

body.zh-TW: 請 Codex 寫程式的同時，你不再需要被動等待它停下才能互動。當它在背景持續運作並向你提出疑問時，現在能直接在行內（inline，直接在當前內容中插入顯示）彈出提問並即時作答。⟦宛如主廚在料理台上全神貫注烹調主菜時，助手從旁遞上調味選擇的便條，主廚能順手打勾或寫上備註，手中的主菜鍋鏟完全不需停下。⟧你可以直接點選介面給出的建議選項，也能自行輸入自訂文字回答。更重要的是，這項互動完全不會清空或影響你原本在輸入框中打到一半的主草稿，確保思緒與進度雙軌推進。
body.en: You no longer have to wait idly for Codex to stop before interacting while it writes code. When Codex runs in the background and asks a question, it can now surface prompt questions inline for immediate replies. ⟦Just like an assistant handing seasoning option slips to a chef focused on cooking a main dish, allowing the chef to check boxes or jot notes without ever putting down the spatula.⟧ You can click suggested options provided by the interface or type custom text responses. Best of all, this interaction will not clear or affect your ongoing main draft in the input box, keeping both your thoughts and progress on track.

items.original: Answer questions inline while Codex continues working, using suggested choices or custom text without losing your main draft. (#42891, #42894, #42897)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援共享背景伺服器，提供守護行程管理指令與自動更新
title.en: Windows Adds Shared Background Server with Daemon Lifecycle Commands and Managed Updates

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境上使用 Codex，多個工作階段現在能共用同一個背景運行的伺服器，不必每個終端機視窗各自啟動一份。這次更新同步引入了守護行程（daemon，在背景持續默默提供服務的常駐程式）生命週期管理指令，讓你能查詢狀態、啟動或終止背景伺服器，同時還納入了託管更新機制，確保背景服務能平順接收後續升級。⟦這好比集合式辦公大樓設置中央公用影印列印中心，各樓層辦公室共用同一組背景運轉的專業主機與管理工具，不必每張桌子都各自擺一台高耗能印表機。⟧
body.en: Multiple sessions on Windows can now share a single background server instead of each terminal window starting its own. This update also introduces daemon lifecycle management commands to check status, start, or stop the background server, alongside managed updates to ensure background services receive future upgrades smoothly. ⟦This is like an office building setting up a central printing center where offices on each floor share the same background professional equipment and management tools, rather than placing power-hungry printers on every desk.⟧

items.original: Windows sessions can now share a background Codex server, with daemon lifecycle commands and managed updates. (#42405, #42392)

title.zh-TW: Vim 編輯新增 R 取代模式，支援復原與重複操作並改善退出鍵
title.en: Vim Editing Adds R Replace Mode with Undo, Dot-Repeat, and Reliable Escape Handling

body.zh-TW: 習慣 Vim 鍵盤操作的開發者，在編輯草稿時手感將更加俐落。這次更新為 Vim 模式補上了經典的 `R` 取代模式，讓你可以直接覆蓋游標處的字元。進行文字替換時，你能按鍵復原（undo，回復到修改前的文字），也能利用小數點鍵重複執行上一次的取代動作。針對舊型終端機，更新也改善了 Escape 鍵的訊號處理，讓跳離編輯模式的操作更可靠，避免按鍵延遲或失靈。⟦此舉有如手寫打字機具備了即時覆蓋色帶，既能直接壓字修正錯別字，又能藉由倒退鍵復原上一步或連打重複印字，同時也把老舊按鍵卡榫徹底潤滑修好。⟧
body.en: Developers accustomed to Vim keybindings will enjoy a snappier draft editing experience. This update brings the classic `R` replace mode to Vim mode, allowing you to overwrite characters directly under the cursor. During text replacement, you can undo changes and use the dot key to repeat your previous replacement action. For legacy terminals, the update improves Escape key handling, making exiting edit modes more reliable and avoiding key delays or failures. ⟦This is like a typewriter equipped with an instant correction ribbon that overwrites typos, allows backspacing to undo or repeating keystrokes, while fully lubricating worn-out mechanical key joints.⟧

items.original: Vim editing gains `R` replace mode with undo and dot-repeat, plus more reliable Escape handling in legacy terminals. (#42194, #42584)

title.zh-TW: 複製回覆保留富文字格式，/copy 指令支援狀態與欄位擷取
title.en: Copying Responses Preserves Rich-Text Formatting as /copy Gains Status and Field Extraction

body.zh-TW: 將對話產生的程式碼或說明貼到其他文書軟體時，排版不再被打亂成純文字了。現在從 Codex 複製回覆內容，貼入支援富文字（rich-text，包含粗體、標題與程式碼區塊等排版樣式）的應用程式時，會完整保留原本的格式外觀。與此同時，命令列工具的 `/copy` 指令也迎來功能強化，除了複製回覆本身，現在還能單獨複製狀態輸出，或是擷取工作階段內的特定個別欄位。⟦一如專業相機輸出照片，既能直接沖洗出帶有完整色彩與層次細節的精緻相片，也可以單獨將相機當前的拍攝數據或特定參數獨立匯出備查。⟧這讓整理文件與分享除錯資訊變得更順暢。
body.en: Pasting generated code or explanations into other document apps will no longer scramble formatting into plain text. Copying responses from Codex into rich-text applications now fully preserves the original styling and appearance. Meanwhile, the command-line `/copy` command has been enhanced to copy status output or extract specific individual fields from a session in addition to the response itself. ⟦Just like a professional camera outputting photos, which can develop fine prints with full color and tonal detail, or independently export current shooting metadata and specific parameters for reference.⟧ This makes organizing documentation and sharing debugging information much smoother.

items.original: Copying responses preserves formatting in rich-text apps, and `/copy` can copy status output or individual session fields. (#42847, #43055)

title.zh-TW: 現有工作階段動態辨識外掛工具，升級回捲自動重新整理
title.en: Existing Sessions Dynamically Detect Plugin Tools and Refresh on Upgrades or Rollbacks

body.zh-TW: 當你手邊的工作階段正在進行，外部外掛有了變更也不需要關掉重開。⟦這如同工廠的工具旋轉吊架，在技師開工期間若由後勤人員掛上新零件或替換工具規格，技師不必停工重開電閘，轉身就能直接拿取最新到貨的工具與操作手冊。⟧既有的工作階段現在具備動態感知能力，能在不中斷執行的情況下，即刻辨識剛安裝好的外掛工具。當外掛在外部完成升級或執行版本回捲時，當前視窗會立即重新整理相應的技能。連同內部定義的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）也會一併更新，確保所有自動化流程即時生效。
body.en: When your current session is running, you no longer need to restart it when external plugins change. ⟦This is like a factory rotating tool rack where logistics staff hang new parts or replace tool specifications while technicians work, allowing technicians to grab newly arrived tools and manuals without shutting down power or halting work.⟧ Existing sessions now feature dynamic detection to recognize newly installed plugin tools without interrupting execution. When plugins are upgraded or rolled back externally, the active window immediately refreshes corresponding skills. Internally defined hooks are updated as well, ensuring all automated workflows take effect immediately.

items.original: Existing sessions pick up newly installed plugin tools and refresh skills and hooks after external plugin upgrades or rollbacks. (#42284, #42593, #42990)

title.zh-TW: MCP 連線協調權杖更新與登入挑戰，舊版伺服器啟動入口退場
title.en: MCP Connections Coordinate Token Refreshes and Login Challenges as Legacy Entry Point Retires

body.zh-TW: 透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）串接外部服務時，授權憑證的維護現在更安全且井然有序。當多個工具連線需要更新 OAuth 授權權杖（token，用來驗證身分的授權令牌）時，Codex 會統一協調這些連線的更新動作。若更新失敗，介面會主動跳出登入驗證挑戰提示，絕不自動重播先前已被拒絕的工具呼叫。此外，先前已被標記為棄用的 `codex mcp-server` 啟動入口也在本次更新中正式移除。⟦猶如園區更新外包廠商的門禁機制，廠商證件過期時由系統集中協調換證，換證失敗即引導人員臨櫃重新認證，絕不拿遭拒的舊卡重複硬刷閘門；同時管理處也正式封閉已張貼告示的舊側門。⟧
body.en: Maintaining authorization credentials when connecting to external services via MCP is now safer and more orderly. When multiple tool connections require OAuth token refreshes, Codex coordinates the refresh across those connections. If a refresh fails, the interface surfaces login challenges without automatically replaying previously rejected tool calls. In addition, the previously deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is officially removed in this release. ⟦This is like an office park updating contractor access control, where expired badges are renewed through centralized coordination, failed renewals direct personnel to service counters for re-verification without repeatedly swiping rejected cards at gates, and management seals off the deprecated side entrance.⟧

items.original:
MCP connections coordinate OAuth token refreshes and surface login challenges when refresh fails, without automatically replaying rejected tool calls. (#42413, #42552)
The deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is no longer available. (#42993)

title.zh-TW: 啟動流程阻擋未信任輔助程式，macOS 沙盒嚴防終端機注入
title.en: Startup Blocks Untrusted Workspace Helpers as macOS Sandbox Prevents Terminal Injection

body.zh-TW: 開啟陌生專案目錄或在蘋果電腦上執行終端機，資安防線在開工當下就已全面就位。現在 Codex 在啟動過程中，若尚未與當前工作區建立明確的信任關係，會主動避免執行任何由工作區控制的輔助程式，杜絕惡意腳本趁虛而入。與此同時，macOS 系統下的沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護層）也經過強化，能確實阻擋未經許可的終端機輸入注入攻擊。⟦這好似進入高度管制的實驗室，外部帶來的隨身器材在通過信任檢驗前一律禁止插電啟動，而隔離艙門的防護隔板也能阻擋外界未授權的按鈕信號干擾。⟧這讓你在檢視未知程式碼時能受到更周密的保護。
body.en: When opening unfamiliar project directories or running terminals on Mac computers, security defenses are active right from the start. During startup, Codex actively avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before establishing trust with the current workspace, preventing malicious scripts from taking advantage. Meanwhile, the macOS sandbox has been strengthened to block unauthorized terminal input injection attacks. ⟦This is like entering a high-security laboratory where personal equipment brought from outside cannot be powered on before trust verification, while containment barriers block unauthorized external button signals.⟧ This ensures thorough protection when inspecting unknown code.

items.original: Startup avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before trust is established, and the macOS sandbox blocks terminal input injection. (#42324, #42590)

title.zh-TW: 遠端續接與分支保留已存權限，新工作階段尊重預設模型
title.en: Remote Resume and Fork Preserve Saved Permissions While Fresh Sessions Follow Default Models

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端環境接續或分流既有進度時，設定與權限將維持一致。當你針對遠端工作階段執行續接（resume，接續先前中斷的進度）或分支操作時，先前已經儲存的授權與權限設定現在會完整延續，省去反覆確認授權的打擾。同時，全新開啟的工作階段以及衍生的分支，除非你在指令中明確指定其他模型，否則一律會嚴格遵守伺服器端配置的預設模型規格。⟦正如跨國企業指派主管遠端接管或分流專案小組，原有的門禁通行權限會自動跟隨繼承，而新立案的分支部門也會直接套用總部規範的標準設備，不必每次連線都重新簽呈。⟧此舉確保了跨端協同作業的權限延續性與環境規範。
body.en: Configurations and permissions remain consistent when resuming or branching progress in remote environments. When performing resume or fork operations on remote sessions, previously saved authorizations and permission settings are preserved, eliminating repetitive authorization prompts. Furthermore, fresh sessions and derived forks strictly respect server-configured default models unless you explicitly specify another model in your command. ⟦Just as a multinational enterprise assigns managers to take over or split project teams remotely, existing access permissions are automatically inherited, while newly chartered branch units adopt standard equipment prescribed by headquarters without requiring new approvals for each connection.⟧ This ensures permission continuity and environmental standards during remote collaboration.

items.original: Remote resume and fork operations preserve saved permissions; fresh sessions and forks respect server model defaults unless explicitly overridden. (#43330, #43177, #43355)

title.zh-TW: 跨應用程式續接對話防衝突，提供唯讀逐字紀錄且保留草稿
title.en: Cross-App Conversation Resume Prevents Conflicts with Read-Only Transcripts and Draft Preservation

body.zh-TW: 當你想接續處理某個對話，但該對話正巧在另一個應用程式中開啟時，現在不必再擔心進度衝突了。⟦彷彿走進銀行閱覽保管箱資料，若另一位共同持有者正在櫃檯查閱正本，行員會先為你提供唯讀對照副本與等候重試號碼牌，並妥善看管你正在填寫的申請表格。⟧Codex 會在介面上顯示唯讀的對話轉錄（transcript，完整對話逐字紀錄），讓你能回顧過往脈絡，並附上重新嘗試的按鈕選項。與此同時，你當前輸入框中正在撰寫的文字草稿也會受到完整保護，不會被清空或覆蓋，方便你在另一端釋放鎖定後立刻接手。
body.en: You no longer have to worry about progress conflicts when resuming a conversation that happens to be open in another application. ⟦It is like visiting a bank vault to inspect documents where, if a co-owner is reviewing the original at the counter, the clerk provides a read-only reference copy and a retry ticket while safeguarding the application form you are filling out.⟧ Codex displays a read-only transcript in the interface so you can review past context, accompanied by a retry button option. Meanwhile, your ongoing text draft in the input box remains protected without being cleared or overwritten, allowing you to take over immediately once the lock is released on the other side.

items.original: Resuming a conversation open in another app now shows a read-only transcript with a retry option while preserving your draft. (#43253)

title.zh-TW: 自動核准審查保留壓縮脈絡，遇新指令自動駁回失效授權
title.en: Automatic Approval Reviews Preserve Compaction Context and Reject Invalidated Authorizations

body.zh-TW: 面對需要反覆審核權限的操作流程，自動審查機制的判斷現在更加嚴謹周全。在對話歷程經歷壓縮（compaction，精簡長對話以節省記憶體的機制）後，自動核准審查機制能更完善地保留原本的授權脈絡，避免重要授權因紀錄濃縮而遺失。更重要的是，一旦使用者在後續給出了全新的指令或補充回答，只要先前的核准因此失效，審查機制就會果斷駁回該項核准，防止舊授權被錯誤套用到新情境。⟦類似於建築師審查工程變更單，即使過往會議紀錄經過摘要精簡，簽核依據依然完整留底；而只要業主中途變更了設計需求，先前簽核的舊工單就會立刻作廢重新評估。⟧
body.en: When dealing with workflows that require repeated permission reviews, automatic approval mechanisms are now more rigorous. Following conversation compaction, automatic approval reviews better preserve original authorization context, preventing critical authorizations from being lost due to history condensation. More importantly, once users provide fresh instructions or supplementary answers that invalidate earlier approvals, the review mechanism promptly rejects those approvals to prevent obsolete authorizations from being misapplied in new contexts. ⟦Similar to an architect reviewing engineering change orders, where approval records remain intact even after past meeting notes are summarized, but previously signed work orders are immediately invalidated for re-evaluation whenever the owner alters design requirements midway.⟧

items.original: Automatic approval reviews better preserve authorization context through compaction and reject approvals invalidated by new user instructions or answers. (#42844, #42852, #43442)

title.zh-TW: 長指令不再被截斷，上下文壓縮依全篇對話分攤預算
title.en: Long prompts stay intact as context compaction shares budgets across turns

body.zh-TW: 和 AI 來回聊上幾十輪之後，開頭交代的大段任務說明不會再被上下文壓縮（context compaction，對話太長時自動濃縮歷史以省空間的機制）硬生生切短。以前壓縮對話時，每段提問都只能分到固定的字數上限；就算後面幾句問答都很簡短，開頭落落長的初始提示詞（prompt）也會被削成一小截。現在改由所有提問彈性分攤預算，只要後續問題短，開頭的指令細節就能完整留下來。摘要與截斷預算也改照模型完整的上下文視窗（context window，模型一次能讀取的最大容量）計算，不再依較窄的壓縮觸發門檻計算，濃縮後的重點與背景任務清單就不會被提早切掉。⟦就像會議紀錄員依照整場會議的長度來分配紙張，以前每位發言人只能分到半頁，現在後面的人講得短，開頭主席的重要報告就能整段謄錄，結尾的待辦清單也不會被裁掉。⟧
body.en: After chatting back and forth for dozens of turns, lengthy opening instructions are no longer aggressively truncated by context compaction. Previously, compaction enforced a rigid length cap on every captured user prompt, lopping off details from a long initial prompt even when all subsequent follow-up turns were brief. The user-request budget is now shared flexibly across all captured prompts, preserving the full context of long instructions whenever later prompts are short. Summary and truncation budgets are also now calculated from the model's full context window rather than the narrower compaction trigger threshold, ensuring compacted summaries and background-task lists are never cut short prematurely. ⟦Like a meeting secretary who allocates notebook space across the whole session: each speaker used to get a fixed half-page, but now brief follow-ups leave plenty of room to record the chair's opening remarks in full without trimming the closing task list.⟧

items.original:
Improved context compaction to spread its user-request budget across all captured prompts, so a long initial instruction is no longer truncated to a small fixed slice when the other prompts in the conversation are short
Improved context compaction to size summary and truncation budgets from the model's full context window instead of the compaction trigger threshold, so compacted summaries and background-task lists are no longer prematurely cut short

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型支援 PDF，多媒體檔案不再報格式不支援
title.en: Custom models support PDFs and stop throwing unsupported mime type errors

body.zh-TW: 在 `settings.json` 裡掛上自訂模型，傳送 PDF 與音訊附件終於不會再報錯。以前丟這類附件或讓工具輸出音訊與文件時，會跳出 `unsupported mime type` 錯誤直接卡住。現在自訂模型預設直接支援 PDF，而且會確實讀取 `modelFeatures` 裡針對 images、video、PDF 與 audio 的媒體旗標，各類多媒體檔案都能依照設定正常送給模型處理。
body.en: Hooking up custom models in `settings.json` no longer throws errors when handling PDF or audio attachments. Previously, attaching these media files or having tools emit audio and document outputs would fail with `unsupported mime type` errors. Custom models now accept PDFs by default and strictly honor the `modelFeatures` media flags for images, video, PDF, and audio, allowing media files to pass to the model as configured.

items.original: Fixed PDF and audio tool outputs and attachments failing with `unsupported mime type` errors on custom models configured in `settings.json`; custom models now accept PDFs by default and honor the `modelFeatures` media flags for images, video, PDF, and audio

title.zh-TW: 按 Ctrl+G 開啟 Vim 不再卡死，編輯提示詞直連終端機
title.en: Pressing Ctrl+G to open Vim no longer hangs when editing prompts

body.zh-TW: 想要在終端機裡好好寫提示詞，按下 `Ctrl+G` 就能跳進 `vim` 這類全螢幕編輯器慢慢改。以前按下快捷鍵時，編輯器常因為輸出沒接對終端機而卡死，畫面上還會跳出 `Vim: Warning: Output is not to a terminal` 警告，整個卡住不動。現在外部編輯器改在真實的終端機標準輸出（stdout）下執行，隨時按 `Ctrl+G` 都能直接打開編輯器，改完存檔離開就立刻回到對話。
body.en: When you want to compose prompts comfortably in the terminal, pressing `Ctrl+G` jumps into a full-screen editor like `vim`. Previously, pressing this shortcut could freeze the editor with a `Vim: Warning: Output is not to a terminal` warning because its output was not connected to a real terminal. External editors now run against a real terminal stdout, so pressing `Ctrl+G` opens your editor immediately and returns you to the conversation as soon as you save and exit.

items.original: Fixed pressing `Ctrl+G` to edit the prompt in a full-screen terminal editor such as `vim` hanging with `Vim: Warning: Output is not to a terminal`; external editors now run against a real terminal stdout

title.zh-TW: 語音聽寫超時草稿不再被清空，錄音滿三分半自動完成轉錄
title.en: Voice dictation no longer erases drafts on timeout and auto-finalizes at 3.5 minutes

body.zh-TW: 對著麥克風講述大段需求，語音聽寫工作階段（session，錄音並即時轉成文字的執行過程）不會再因為講太久而把草稿整段抹掉。以前錄音只要超過 4 分鐘，就會觸發時限錯誤直接宣告失敗，講了老半天的轉錄草稿也跟著全部消失。現在錄音只要滿 3 分 30 秒就會自動停止並完成轉錄，講完的內容會好好轉成文字，不再怕超時白講一場。
body.en: Speaking lengthy prompts into your microphone no longer risks losing your entire draft to a timeout during voice dictation sessions. Previously, recordings exceeding 4 minutes triggered a deadline error and failed completely, discarding the entire drafted transcript. Recordings now automatically stop and finalize at 3 minutes 30 seconds, reliably converting your spoken words into text so you never lose your progress.

items.original: Fixed voice dictation sessions longer than 4 minutes failing with a deadline error and erasing the drafted transcription; recordings now automatically stop and finalize at 3 minutes 30 seconds

title.zh-TW: 個人帳號啟動畫面更乾淨，不再誤顯示 Google Cloud 專案代碼
title.en: Startup banner no longer mistakenly shows a Google Cloud Project ID for personal accounts

body.zh-TW: 一般個人帳號登入命令列工具，終端機畫面上方不會再跳出讓人摸不著頭緒的雲端專案字樣。以前非企業的個人帳號登入時，終端機頂端的啟動橫幅會誤印出 Google Cloud 專案代碼（Project ID）。現在修好了，個人帳號登入時不會再看到這串跟你無關的代碼。
body.en: Signing in with a standard consumer account now keeps your terminal free of confusing enterprise cloud identifiers. Previously, non-enterprise personal sign-ins mistakenly showed a Google Cloud Project ID in the startup banner at the top of the terminal. This is now fixed, so personal sign-ins no longer see an ID that has nothing to do with them.

items.original: Fixed the startup banner displaying a Google Cloud Project ID for consumer (non-enterprise) sign-ins

title.zh-TW: 複雜步驟對話載入不再當機，分岔對話徹底隔離舊資料
title.en: Complex conversation steps load without crashes and forked histories stay cleanly isolated

body.zh-TW: 包含子代理或排程步驟的複雜對話，現在讀取紀錄或分岔分支都變得穩固。以前對話裡只要有背景任務、子代理管理、訊息傳遞或排程步驟，重新載入或壓縮對話時就容易觸發堆疊溢位（stack-overflow，記憶體堆疊空間耗盡導致當機）而整台程式崩潰。另外，把對話分岔（fork，從既有對話的某個時間點複製出新分支）時，新分支以前會誤把分岔點之後的舊步驟輸出抄進來，跟分岔後產生的新步驟打架。現在這兩處都已修好，載入不再崩潰，分岔後的資料也乾淨隔開。⟦翻開厚厚的工作企劃夾，重讀多組交辦與排程紀錄時不會讓活頁夾散掉，從中途另存一份新企劃時，也不會把原本後半段的舊進度混進新計畫裡。⟧
body.en: Complex multi-agent conversations with background tasks or scheduling steps now load and branch reliably. Previously, reloading or compacting conversations containing background-task, subagent-management, messaging, or scheduling steps could trigger a stack-overflow crash that halted the program. In addition, when forking a conversation, the new branch mistakenly inherited step output data from steps after the fork point, clashing with freshly generated steps. Both issues are now resolved: loading no longer crashes and forked histories stay cleanly separated. ⟦Picture a thick project binder: reviewing multi-team handoffs and schedules no longer bursts the binder rings, and branching a new draft midway stops old downstream milestones from cluttering the new plan.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a stack-overflow crash when loading or compacting conversations containing background-task, subagent-management, messaging, or scheduling steps
Fixed forked conversations inheriting step output data from steps after the fork point, which could collide with new steps produced in the fork

title.zh-TW: 修復背景資源洩漏，中途取消與結束程式都不再拖泥帶水
title.en: Background leaks fixed, canceled requests abort instantly, and CLI quits without delay

body.zh-TW: 命令列工具開了一整天，或是中途取消建立工作區，背景都不會再偷偷累積記憶體或霸佔資源。以前每個對話工作階段（session）都會漏掉背景輪詢器與計時器，開越久記憶體吃越多。要是你中途取消建立對話或工作區，背景還會傻傻繼續調度資源，現在只要取消就會立刻中止作業。想關掉工具離開時，以前也得乾等 5 秒強制逾時才能結束，現在關閉時會直接中斷未結的串流連線，按退出就能秒關。以前開久了電腦變慢、取消還佔資源、退出又得乾等的麻煩，現在一次全清乾淨了。
body.en: Running the CLI all day or canceling workspace creation will no longer leak memory or hold onto orphaned resources in the background. Previously, every conversation session leaked a background poller and timer, steadily accumulating memory over long sessions. If you canceled a conversation or workspace creation, the background continued provisioning resources; aborted requests now halt immediately. Quitting the CLI also used to force an extra 5-second wait for a timeout, but shutdown now severs open streaming connections immediately to exit on the spot. Sluggish memory bloat, stuck background provisioning, and slow exits are all resolved.

items.original:
Fixed a background poller and timer leaking for every conversation session, slowly accumulating memory over long-running sessions
Fixed canceled conversation and workspace creation requests continuing to provision resources in the background; aborted requests now stop immediately
Fixed quitting the CLI taking around 5 extra seconds before the process exited; shutdown now cancels open streaming connections immediately instead of waiting for a forced timeout

title.zh-TW: 產出物檢視器支援圖形渲染，數學公式與流程圖直接預覽
title.en: Artifact Viewer Supports Graphics Rendering with Direct Previews for Math Equations and Flowcharts

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中開啟產出物詳細檢視器時，現在能直接看到圖形化數學公式與流程圖。⟦這好比在閱讀數位筆記時，原本只能看到由文字符號拼排的原始代碼，現在翻開內頁就像自動載入高畫質插圖，複雜的方程式與流程圖直接以視覺圖案精緻呈現。⟧新機制在支援 Kitty 協定的終端機中，能直接在檢視器畫面中渲染 LaTeX 數學公式（包括 `$$...$$` 與 `math`、`latex`、`tex` 程式碼區塊），以及 Mermaid 流程圖和循序圖。若終端機不支援該協定，畫面會自動切換為 Unicode ASCII 純文字作為備援。遇到較寬的圖表時，你可以使用左右方向鍵進行水平平移；隨時按下 `m` 鍵，還可在影像、ASCII 以及原始文字三種檢視模式之間循環切換。
body.en: When opening the artifact detail viewer in the terminal, you can now directly view rendered graphical math equations and flowcharts. ⟦It is like reading digital notes where you previously only saw raw code cobbled together with text symbols, but now turning the page automatically loads high-resolution illustrations, presenting complex equations and flowcharts in refined visual diagrams.⟧ On terminals supporting the Kitty protocol, the new mechanism renders LaTeX math equations (including `$$...$$` and `math`, `latex`, and `tex` code blocks) alongside Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams inline in the viewer. If a terminal does not support the protocol, the display automatically falls back to plain Unicode ASCII text. For wider diagrams, you can use the Left and Right arrow keys to pan horizontally. Pressing the `m` key cycles between Image, ASCII, and Raw text view modes at any time.

items.original: Added inline Kitty graphics rendering for LaTeX math equations (`$$...$$` and fenced `math`, `latex`, and `tex` blocks) and Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams in the artifact detail viewer, with Unicode ASCII fallback, Left/Right arrow horizontal panning for wide diagrams, and `m` to cycle between Image, ASCII, and Raw views

title.zh-TW: 提問互動提示操作升級，支援左右換題與自填預覽
title.en: Interactive Question Prompt Upgraded with Left/Right Navigation and Write-In Previews

body.zh-TW: AI 一口氣丟來好幾個釐清問題時，填答畫面現在讓你前後翻題，也看得出哪幾題已經答過。⟦好比填寫多頁的紙本問卷，現在你可以隨時往前翻閱已作答的題目確認細節，手寫補充的欄位會整齊謄在預覽處，已選項目蓋有清楚的勾選標記，翻到最後一頁時按下確認就能一次繳回整份問卷。⟧提示介面現在支援使用左右方向鍵在多個問題之間自由切換與回顧。若選擇自行填寫答案，確認送出後的文字會直接在行內即時預覽；已經完成選取的選項旁會標註勾選符號，讓整體作答狀態一目了然。當你瀏覽到最後一個問題時，直接按下確認即可一步完成整份送出。
body.en: When the AI asks several clarifying questions at once, the answer screen now lets you move back and forth between them and see which ones you have already answered. ⟦Much like filling out a multi-page paper survey where you can flip back to review answered questions, see handwritten supplementary notes neatly transcribed into a preview area, verify answered options stamped with clear check marks, and submit the entire questionnaire in one go upon confirming the final page.⟧ The prompt interface now supports using the Left and Right arrow keys to freely switch between and review questions. If you choose to write in an answer, confirmed text is previewed inline in real time. Answered options display check marks so your response status is clear at a glance. When you navigate to the final question, pressing confirm submits the entire set in a single step.

items.original: Improved the `ask_question` interactive prompt with Left/Right arrow navigation between questions, inline previews of confirmed write-in answers, check marks on answered options, and single-step submission on the final question

title.zh-TW: 自訂規則享有專屬額度，不再擠壓技能與外部工具
title.en: Custom Rules Receive Dedicated Token Budget Without Evicting Skills or External Tools

body.zh-TW: 載入龐大的專案規範與自訂規則時，其他擴充功能不再因為空間不足而被無預警捨棄。⟦宛如整理隨身行李箱時規劃了專屬夾層，即使放入整疊筆記也只會佔用該夾層的專用容量，並在分頁處整齊切齊，絕不會把隨身工具包或精密儀器擠出行李箱外。⟧系統現在為使用者與工作區規則分配了專屬的 20,000 個 token（AI 處理文字的計量單位）預算配額。超出上限的規則會在換行邊界處自動截斷，並透過檔案路徑與描述清楚列出超額清單。這項獨立配額確保了龐大的規則清單不會再擠掉技能、工作流程、子代理或 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）等重要工具。
body.en: When loading extensive project guidelines and custom rules, other extensions are no longer discarded without warning due to space constraints. ⟦Just like designing a dedicated compartment in a travel suitcase where a thick stack of notebooks only consumes that compartment's designated capacity and is trimmed neatly at page margins, preventing toolkits or precision instruments from being squeezed out.⟧ The system now allocates a dedicated 20,000-token budget for user and workspace rules. Oversized rules are automatically truncated at newline boundaries, with over-budget rules clearly listed by file path and description. This independent quota ensures that large rule sets no longer evict essential tools such as skills, workflows, subagents, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

items.original: Improved customization token budgeting by giving user and workspace rules a dedicated 20,000-token budget (cutting oversized rules on newline boundaries and listing over-budget rules by path and description) so large rule sets no longer evict skills, workflows, subagents, or MCP tools

title.zh-TW: 預設代理工具組去蕪存菁，舊版搜尋與目錄工具退役
title.en: Default Agent Toolset Streamlined with Legacy Search and Directory Tools Retired

body.zh-TW: 代理一啟動就帶在身上的工具箱，這版拿掉了三個舊的搜尋與列目錄工具。⟦好比隨身維修包將已經被新型工具涵蓋的舊式單一扳手與量尺移出基本標配，讓隨身工具袋保持俐落；但若是特殊任務的作業手冊明確指名，你依然能隨時將它們放回工具箱中。⟧系統改進了工具配置基準線，將舊版的 `find_by_name`、`grep_search` 以及 `list_dir` 工具從預設工具組中淘汰。這項調整能精簡代理預設攜帶的工具清單，避免多餘工具造成干擾。若你的自訂代理依然需要這些舊工具，只要在設定檔的 `tools` 清單中明確列出，依然可以照常呼叫與使用。
body.en: The toolbox agents carry from the moment they start drops three legacy search and directory-listing tools in this release. ⟦Like a portable repair kit removing older single-purpose wrenches and rulers that are already superseded by modern tools, keeping the toolkit nimble while still allowing you to pack them back in whenever a specialized manual specifically demands them.⟧ The system refines the baseline tool configuration by retiring the legacy `find_by_name`, `grep_search`, and `list_dir` tools from the default toolset. This change streamlines the list of tools carried by agents by default, avoiding distractions caused by redundant tools. If your custom agents still require these legacy tools, you can continue calling and using them as usual by explicitly declaring them in the `tools` list of your configuration.

items.original: Improved the default agent and subagent toolset by retiring the legacy `find_by_name`, `grep_search`, and `list_dir` tools from the default baseline while keeping them available to custom agents that explicitly list them in `tools`

title.zh-TW: 外掛程式指令前綴與背景程序修復，升級快取清理更乾淨
title.en: Plugin Slash Command Prefix and Background Process Fixes with Cleaner Upgrade Cache Pruning

body.zh-TW: 外掛裝多了以後，指令名稱互相打架、升級完舊程式還賴在背景，這幾個毛病這版都處理了。⟦彷彿模組化機房在更換新組件時，主控端會徹底關閉舊機台的殘留線路並清空廢棄零件存放區，控制面板也不會因為零件名稱重複而印錯開關代號，停用的模組依然能隨時在總清單中找回。⟧系統修復了外掛技能的斜線指令在設定名稱自帶前綴時會出現雙重前綴（如 `/<plugin>:<plugin>:<skill>`）的錯誤，並解決了多個外掛定義相同簡稱技能時指令遭到遮蔽的問題。外掛升級時，系統不再讓舊的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器與 sidecar 行程在已刪除的安裝目錄中持續殘留運作。啟動時也會主動清理市集快取（把下載檔案暫存起來的空間）中已被取代的舊版外掛與暫存目錄。此外，已停用的外掛不會再因只查詢啟用項目的指令而自 `/plugin` 清單中消失，移除外掛時也強化了外掛識別碼的路徑驗證。
body.en: With several plugins installed, command names could clash and old processes could linger after an upgrade; this release deals with both. ⟦Much like swapping components in a modular server room where the controller terminates lingering connections from decommissioned units, clears out obsolete spare parts storage, prevents duplicate part names from printing incorrect switch identifiers on the panel, and still lets you locate disabled modules in the master inventory.⟧ The system fixes an issue where plugin skill slash commands received double prefixes (such as `/<plugin>:<plugin>:<skill>`) when the frontmatter name already included the plugin prefix, and resolves command shadowing when multiple plugins define skills with the same short name. During plugin upgrades, legacy MCP servers and sidecar processes are no longer left running from deleted installation directories. Startup now actively prunes superseded plugin versions and staging directories from the marketplace cache. Additionally, disabled plugins no longer disappear from the `/plugin` list after enabled-only customization queries, and path validation for plugin IDs has been hardened during uninstallation.

items.original:
Fixed plugin skill slash commands being double-prefixed (`/<plugin>:<plugin>:<skill>`) when a skill's frontmatter name already includes the plugin prefix, or being shadowed when multiple plugins define skills with the same short name
Fixed plugin upgrades leaving old MCP server and sidecar processes running from deleted install directories, and pruned superseded plugin versions and staging directories from the marketplace cache on startup
Fixed disabled plugins disappearing from the `/plugin` list after enabled-only customization queries, and hardened plugin ID path validation on uninstall

title.zh-TW: 終端機橫幅顯示企業專案，用量面板去除重複配額文字
title.en: Terminal Startup Banner Displays Enterprise Project and Usage Panel Removes Duplicate Quota Text

body.zh-TW: 兩個常看的畫面這版變清楚了：啟動時的歡迎橫幅，和查額度的 `/usage` 面板。⟦恰似車輛儀表板在重新整合後，頂部狀態欄直接標記當前連接的行車系統專案代碼，底部的油量指示條也移除了重複堆疊的小字，讓關鍵資訊一目了然。⟧企業帳號在啟動命令列工具時，啟動橫幅現在會在登入帳號與方案層級下方，清楚標示當前作用中的 Google Cloud 專案識別碼（Project ID）。同時，`/usage` 用量查詢面板也移除了每個進度條下方重複顯示的剩餘配額百分比文字，讓整體畫面更為清爽緊湊。
body.en: Two screens you look at often got clearer in this release: the startup banner and the `/usage` quota panel. ⟦Much like a redesigned vehicle dashboard that displays the active navigation system project code directly on the top status bar and eliminates redundant stacked fine print beneath the fuel gauge, making key information clear at a glance.⟧ When enterprise accounts launch the command-line tool, the startup banner now clearly displays the active Google Cloud Project ID beneath the signed-in account and plan tier. Meanwhile, the `/usage` panel removes the duplicate remaining-quota percentage text beneath each progress bar, resulting in a cleaner and more compact interface.

items.original:
Improved the CLI startup banner for enterprise accounts to display the active Google Cloud Project ID beneath the signed-in account and plan tier
Improved the `/usage` panel by removing the duplicate remaining-quota percentage line beneath each progress bar

title.zh-TW: 模型重試等待上限縮減至 30 秒，連線異常恢復更迅速
title.en: Model API Retry Backoff Capped at 30 Seconds for Faster Recovery from Connection Failures

body.zh-TW: 模型 API 一時連不上時，你不必再盯著停住的終端機乾等好幾分鐘。以前在觸發重試機制時，每次重試之間的退避等待時間會逐步拉長，單次最長甚至需要等待多達 4 分鐘，導致終端機長時間停滯。⟦這就像撥打客服專線遇忙線時，自動重撥系統改為最多每隔半分鐘重新撥號一次，不再讓你對著話筒乾等數分鐘才重試。⟧現在系統將單次重試的退避等待時間上限嚴格限制在 30 秒，縮短連線遇阻時的等待空檔，讓對話能更快恢復順暢交流。
body.en: When the model API briefly fails, you no longer have to stare at a stalled terminal for minutes. Previously, when triggering retries, the backoff delay between attempts grew progressively longer, taking up to 4 minutes for a single wait and leaving the terminal stalled for extended periods. ⟦This is like calling a busy customer service hotline where the automated redial system now tries again at most every half minute, instead of leaving you waiting on the line for minutes before redialing.⟧ The system now strictly caps the per-attempt retry backoff at 30 seconds, reducing idle waiting intervals during connectivity hiccups so conversations can resume smoothly much faster.

items.original: Improved model API retry responsiveness by capping per-attempt retry backoff at 30 seconds instead of waiting up to 4 minutes between attempts

title.zh-TW: 終端機退出渲染與無頭模式修復，背景日誌與記憶體最佳化
title.en: Terminal Exit Rendering and Headless Mode Fixes with Background Logging and Memory Optimizations

body.zh-TW: 如果你常用 `-p` 讓它在背景自己跑，或習慣在終端機裡清畫面、退出，這幾項修正都跟你有關。⟦好比後台自動化工作站一邊運作，一邊將各個工具的進度即時抄錄進專屬日誌檔案，同時定期整理過長的文件摘要以節省桌面空間，在操作員關閉工作站時也能乾淨還原周邊設備的通訊狀態。⟧系統將 Bubble Tea 框架升級至 v2.0.9，修復了終端機畫面渲染問題，以及在離開工具或清除畫面時 Kitty 鍵盤通訊協定堆疊的處理異常。在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）使用 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行時，修復了偶爾漏掉背景任務等待通知的問題。背景 SDK 工具的執行進度現在會確實記錄至任務記錄檔中，並透過複製截斷的指令輸出預覽來降低記憶體用量。
body.en: If you often run it headless with `-p`, or routinely clear the screen and exit in the terminal, these fixes apply to you. ⟦Like an automated back-office workstation that logs individual tool progress into dedicated log files in real time while periodically tidying up lengthy document previews to conserve desk space, and cleanly restores peripheral communication states when an operator shuts down the workstation.⟧ The system upgrades the Bubble Tea framework to v2.0.9, resolving terminal rendering issues and anomalies in Kitty keyboard protocol stack handling upon exiting the tool or clearing the screen. When running in headless mode using `-p` or `--prompt`, an issue where background-task waiting notices were occasionally skipped has been fixed. Execution progress for background SDK tools is now reliably recorded in task log files, and memory usage is reduced by cloning truncated command output previews.

items.original:
Fixed terminal rendering and Kitty keyboard protocol stack handling on exit and screen clear by upgrading Bubble Tea to v2.0.9
Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs occasionally skipping the background-task waiting notice, logged background SDK tool progress to task log files, and reduced memory usage by cloning truncated command output previews

title.zh-TW: 啟動命令列工具不再影響桌面版對話釘選與已讀狀態
title.en: Starting CLI No Longer Alters Desktop App Conversation Pinning or Read States

body.zh-TW: 以前在電腦上啟動命令列工具時，可能會意外干擾桌面應用程式（desktop app）的狀態，導致原本釘選的對話被取消釘選，或是已讀過的對話被重新標記為未讀。現在這個問題已經修好，啟動命令列工具不會再誤改桌面版應用程式中的對話標記與釘選狀態。
body.en: Previously, launching the CLI on your computer could inadvertently interfere with desktop app state, causing pinned conversations to be unpinned or read conversations to be marked as unread. This issue has now been resolved, ensuring that starting the CLI will no longer unintentionally modify conversation read flags or pinned states in the desktop application.

items.original: Fixed starting the CLI unpinning conversations or marking them unread in the desktop app

title.zh-TW: 遠端操控正式推出，隨時隨地跨裝置同步接手對話
title.en: Remote Control Officially Launches for Cross-Device Session Handoff

body.zh-TW: 想暫時離開電腦又想隨時盯緊 AI 的執行進度，現在你可以直接用另一台裝置接手。⟦宛如客廳電視遊樂器開啟跨裝置鏡射，在平板完成配對後，即使走到廚房也能同步觀看畫面並直接操作控制器；退出連線或關機時通道也會立即關閉以保安全。⟧你在開啟工具時加上 `--remote-control` 旗標，或在對話中輸入 `/remote-control` 指令，就能建立專屬連線，從手機或平板即時跟隨與控制終端機。輸入 `/remote-control off` 或關閉工作階段（session）時，系統會自動拆除通道並註銷裝置清單。這項連線也修好了權限繼承問題，遠端發起的指令會完整套用原本設定的權限模式、循環模式與檔案存取授權；即使資料目錄名稱不同，配套介面也能如實呈現豐富的產物卡片。
body.en: If you want to step away from your computer while keeping a close eye on AI progress, you can now take over directly from another device. ⟦Just like enabling cross-device mirroring on a living room console, where pairing with a tablet lets you watch the screen and operate the controller even while walking into the kitchen, with the tunnel immediately closing upon disconnecting or shutting down for safety.⟧ By adding the `--remote-control` flag when launching the tool or typing the `/remote-control` command in a conversation, you can create a dedicated connection to follow and control the terminal in real time from a phone or tablet. Typing `/remote-control off` or closing the session automatically tears down the tunnel and unregisters the device list. This connection also fixes permission inheritance issues, ensuring commands initiated remotely fully inherit the original permission mode, cycle mode, and file access grants. Even when data directory names differ, the companion interface faithfully renders rich artifact cards.

items.original:
Added Remote Control (start a connection via `--remote-control` startup flag or `/remote-control` slash command) to create a session-scoped remote connection for following and controlling your active terminal session from another device. Typing `/remote-control off` or closing the session automatically tears down the tunnel and unregisters the device from the active Remote Control session list.
Fixed turns triggered from a connected Remote Control session or running across secondary workspaces executing without the CLI session's active permission mode, cycle mode, and non-workspace file access grants.
Fixed artifacts in the Remote Control companion rendering as plain `<name>.md` file links instead of rich artifact cards when the CLI's application data directory differs from the default bundle name.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式解除執行時限，背景伺服器常駐且錯誤排查更精準
title.en: Headless Mode Removes Execution Time Limits, Keeps Background Servers Running, and Improves Error Diagnostics

body.zh-TW: 把耗時的繁重任務交給自動化腳本執行時，無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）現在不會因為時間到了就強制中斷。⟦恰如工廠在夜間啟動無人值守的自動化流水線，只要不設關機定時器，機台就會耐心運轉直至所有工件加工完畢；若是途中遇上原料斷供或故障，控制面板立刻印出含錯誤代碼的結構化清單。⟧使用 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行時，預設逾時已從 5 分鐘調整為無限制，讓耗時較長的任務能一路執行到回覆完畢，除非手動加上 `--print-timeout` 參數。在具備 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 的工作階段中，背景伺服器指令也會在回合結束後保持運作。此外，當因 API 失敗中斷時，CLI 在標準錯誤輸出 `AGY_ERROR: {...}` JSON 紀錄，詳列標準狀態、HTTP 或 gRPC 錯誤代碼、是否可重試與錯誤識別碼，並將結束代碼改為 `3`。
body.en: When handing off time-consuming heavy tasks to automation scripts, headless mode no longer forcibly terminates when time runs out. ⟦Just like starting an unattended automated assembly line in a factory at night, where machines run patiently until all workpieces are processed unless a shutdown timer is set, and the control panel immediately prints a structured list with error codes if materials run out or a breakdown occurs midway.⟧ When running with `-p` or `--prompt`, the default timeout has been changed from 5 minutes to unlimited, allowing long-running tasks to execute until the response finishes unless the `--print-timeout` parameter is passed manually. In sessions with `GEMINI_API_KEY`, background server commands also remain running after the turn ends. Additionally, when terminated due to an API failure, the CLI prints an `AGY_ERROR: {...}` JSON record to standard error detailing canonical status, HTTP or gRPC error codes, retryability, and error IDs, while updating the exit code to `3`.

items.original:
Changed the default timeout for headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs from 5 minutes to unlimited so long-running agent turns run until the response completes unless `--print-timeout` is passed explicitly, and enabled daemon background commands in headless `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions so background servers stay running after the turn finishes.
Improved headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) error reporting when a turn terminates on an agent or model API failure: the CLI now prints a structured `AGY_ERROR: {...}` JSON line on stderr with canonical status, HTTP or gRPC error code, retryability, and error ID (including HTTP status mapping for `GEMINI_API_KEY` SDK errors) and exits with code `3` instead of `1`.

title.zh-TW: 編輯器游標支援標點斷詞，路徑與參數修改更俐落
title.en: Editor Cursor Supports Punctuation Boundaries for Snappier Path and Flag Editing

body.zh-TW: 鍵盤游標在提示詞編輯器中穿梭時，單詞跳轉與文字刪除變得更加細膩。以前按下單詞跳轉快捷鍵時，游標只會在空格處停下，如果遇到用斜線或符號連接的長網址，一跳就會衝過頭，刪除時也會把整串路徑一口氣刪光。⟦這就像長途列車原本只能在縣市大站停靠，現在每一處轉運站的交接月台都能精準煞停，讓你能隨心所欲單獨檢視或卸下某個特定車廂。⟧現在系統改進了分詞規則，游標移動快捷鍵（如 `Alt+F`、`Alt+B` 以及方向鍵組合）遇到標點符號時都會主動停下。單詞刪除鍵（如 `Ctrl+W`、`Alt+Backspace` 和 `Alt+D`）同樣會在標點邊界煞停。無論是檔案路徑中的各層目錄、網址或是各項參數設定，你都能精準按節跳轉或逐步刪除。
body.en: Word navigation and text deletion have become much more refined when moving the keyboard cursor through the prompt editor. Previously, when pressing word-navigation shortcuts, the cursor only stopped at whitespace, causing it to overshoot long URLs joined by slashes or symbols and wipe out entire path strings when deleting. ⟦This is like a long-distance train that could only stop at major city stations, but can now halt precisely at transfer platforms at every transit hub, letting you inspect or detach a specific railcar at will.⟧ The system has now improved word boundary rules so cursor movement shortcuts (such as `Alt+F`, `Alt+B`, and arrow key combinations) actively stop at punctuation marks. Word deletion shortcuts (such as `Ctrl+W`, `Alt+Backspace`, and `Alt+D`) likewise stop at punctuation boundaries. Whether dealing with directory levels in file paths, URLs, or various parameter flags, you can now navigate precisely by segment or delete step by step.

items.original: Improved word-wise cursor movement (`Alt+F`, `Alt+B`, and `Ctrl`/`Alt`+Arrow keys) and word deletion (`Ctrl+W`, `Alt+Backspace`, and `Alt+D`) in the prompt editor to stop at punctuation boundaries instead of only whitespace, making it easy to step through or delete individual segments of file paths, URLs, and flags.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕產物檢視器純文字複製，不再誤選行號與留白
title.en: Full-Screen Artifact Viewer Copies Plain Text Without Accidentally Selecting Line Numbers and Padding

body.zh-TW: 滑鼠在全螢幕產物檢視器中拖曳選取時，複製出來的內容不再夾帶多餘雜訊。以前只要滑鼠拖曳過螢幕，系統就會連同最左側的行號邊緣欄以及右側的尾隨間距一併選入，貼上時還得手動刪除行號。現在這個問題已經修好，拖曳只會反白並複製文件本身的文字內容；你還能隨時按下 `Ctrl+C` 重新複製當前選取的範圍、按 `Esc` 清除選取，或是使用 `Shift` 鍵搭配拖曳來保留原生終端機的選取方式。
body.en: When dragging to select with the mouse in the full-screen artifact viewer, copied content no longer includes unwanted noise. Previously, dragging across the screen would capture the leftmost line-number gutter along with trailing padding on the right, requiring you to manually delete line numbers after pasting. This issue has now been fixed: dragging highlights and copies only the document text content itself. You can also press `Ctrl+C` at any time to re-copy the active selection, press `Esc` to clear the selection, or hold `Shift` while dragging to retain native terminal selection.

items.original: Fixed text selection in the full-screen artifact viewer capturing the line-number gutter and trailing padding; dragging across the viewer now highlights and copies only the document text, with `Ctrl+C` to re-copy an active selection, `Esc` to clear it, and `Shift`+drag for native terminal selection.

title.zh-TW: 執行中切換模型改為依序排隊，進行中對話不再中途遭換
title.en: Mid-Run Model Switches Now Queue in Order Without Swapping In-Flight Turns

body.zh-TW: 趁著 AI 正在回答問題時提前輸入下一句指示並指定模型，現在系統會乖乖排隊而不會打亂現狀。以前在回合運作中途輸入 `/model <name> <prompt>` 指令，系統會立刻切換執行中的模型，導致正在產出的內容中途被換掉。這個問題已經修好，單次模型切換現在會耐心等待，直到該筆排隊的提示詞正式開始執行時才會切換，確保當前進行中的回合與更早排隊的提示詞，都能完整使用工作階段（session）原本的模型順利跑完。
body.en: When entering a subsequent instruction with a specified model while the AI is actively answering, the system now queues it properly without disrupting ongoing work. Previously, submitting the `/model <name> <prompt>` command midway through a running turn would immediately switch the active model, causing in-flight generations to be swapped mid-stream. This issue has now been fixed: one-shot model switches now wait patiently until the queued prompt begins executing, ensuring both the currently running turn and any earlier queued prompts finish completely on the session's original model.

items.original: Fixed submitting `/model <name> <prompt>` while a turn is already running switching the active model immediately in the middle of the in-flight turn; the one-shot model switch now waits until the queued prompt begins executing so the running turn and any earlier queued prompts finish on the session's original model.

title.zh-TW: 超大變更不撐爆對話儲存，倒帶復原不再誤覆寫成果
title.en: Oversized Edits No Longer Exceed Session Storage, and Rewind Reverts Avoid Overwriting Work

body.zh-TW: 遇到超大檔案變更或需要倒帶復原進度時，工作階段（session）的儲存與工作區狀態現在更加穩固。⟦宛如厚重帳本在歸檔龐大資料時，只記錄增減行數與摘要而省略整份原始收據，避免抽屜爆滿被整箱清空；翻查紀錄時也會精準比對目標頁數，不再盲目拿過期的舊存根來覆寫現狀。⟧以前當檔案修改的差異內容大於 1 MiB 時，會因超出對話儲存上限而導致整個工作階段被強制清空。現在超大編輯會保留行數變更統計，並自儲存歷程中省略龐大的原始差異內容，在執行 `/rewind` 時也會直接略過省略部分。此外，過去使用 `/rewind` 進行對話復原或建立分支時，若略過了近期的快照，系統可能會倒退掃描至過舊的工作區快照，默默覆寫保留的修改；現在尋找快照會從目標步驟向前搜尋，若無較新快照則採用逐步復原重播作為備援。
body.en: When encountering massive file changes or rewinding progress, session storage and workspace states are now significantly more stable. ⟦Just like a thick ledger archiving voluminous records by logging only line counts and summaries while omitting bulky raw receipts to prevent overflowing drawers from being dumped out entirely, and referencing precise target page numbers during audits rather than blindly overwriting the present with outdated stubs.⟧ Previously, when file modification diffs exceeded 1 MiB, exceeding the conversation storage limit would force-clear the entire session. Oversized edits now preserve line-change statistics while omitting the massive raw diff content from stored history, and `/rewind` directly skips elided diffs during reverts. Additionally, when using `/rewind` for conversation reverts or forks in the past, skipping recent snapshots could cause the system to sweep backward to an outdated workspace snapshot and silently overwrite kept modifications. Snapshot lookup now sweeps forward from the target step, falling back to step-by-step revert replay when no newer snapshot exists.

items.original:
Fixed file edits with diffs larger than 1 MiB exceeding the conversation storage limit and force-clearing the session; oversized edits now preserve their line-change statistics while omitting the raw diff body from stored conversation history and skipping the elided diff during `/rewind` reverts.
Fixed `/rewind` conversation reverts and forks sweeping backward to an older workspace snapshot when recent snapshot commits were skipped, which could silently overwrite kept work; snapshot lookup now sweeps forward from the target step and falls back to step-by-step revert replay when no later snapshot exists.

title.zh-TW: HTML 報表改用卡片排版，字體與圖表標籤放大到看得清
title.en: HTML report switches to card layout with enlarged typography and chart labels

body.zh-TW: 打開 usage 產出的 HTML 報表，現在每個區塊都收進外框一致的儀表板卡片裡。以前整頁報表只靠細線分段，頁面一長很難看清哪裡是哪裡；現在上方四張摘要卡共用同一個三列格線，數字整齊切齊。內文與數值一律換成無襯線字體配等寬數字，等寬字體只留給頂部的指令與 `[usage]>` 前綴。整體色調轉為中性，token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量不再是土黃色，綠色則專門留給趨勢與尖峰。圖表上的文字也同步變大，坐標軸標籤從 9px 放大到 12px、圖例從 .7rem 放大到 .8rem，時段軸與熱力圖的月份及星期標籤都變大了，解決以前在普通螢幕上看不清的困擾。⟦就像展覽的導覽手冊，以前整本只用幾條細線隔開長篇文字，現在改成一張張分好類的解說牌，字也印大了，站遠一點也看得清。⟧
body.en: When you open the HTML report generated by usage, each section is now neatly organized inside a consistent dashboard card. Previously, the entire report was split only by thin divider lines, making it hard to navigate down a long page; now the four summary cards at the top share a single three-row grid, keeping numbers aligned. Body text and numbers uniformly share a sans-serif typeface paired with tabular figures, keeping monospace only for the command line at the top and the `[usage]>` prefix. The color palette shifted to neutral tones, token counts are no longer amber, and green is reserved exclusively for trends and peaks.
